title.zh: 卷一百九十 志第一百四十三 兵四
title.raw: 卷一百九十 志第一百四十三 兵四 Volume 190 Treatises 143: Military 4

sentences.zh: 鄉兵一

translations.literal: Local Militia 1
translations.idiomatic: Local Militia, Part 1

sentences.zh: 鄉兵者，選自戶籍，或土民應募，在所團結訓練，以爲防守之兵也。

translations.literal: As for local militia, they are selected from household registers, or local people respond to recruitment; they are organized and trained in their locality to serve as defensive troops.
translations.idiomatic: Local militia were drawn from household registers or recruited among local inhabitants, then organized and drilled in their districts to serve as defensive forces.

sentences.zh: 周廣順中，點秦州稅戶充保毅軍，宋因之。

translations.literal: In the Guangshun era of Zhou, tax-paying households of Qin Prefecture were selected to fill the Baoyi Army; Song followed this practice.
translations.idiomatic: During the Later Zhou reign era Guangshun, tax-registered households in Qin Prefecture were drafted into the Baoyi corps, and the Song continued the system.

sentences.zh: 自建隆四年，分命使臣往關西道，令調發鄉兵赴慶州。

translations.literal: From the fourth year of Jianlong onward, envoys were separately dispatched to the Guanxi circuit to order the mobilization of local militia to Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning in the fourth year of Jianlong, imperial envoys were sent in turn to the Guanxi circuit to mobilize local militia for Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 咸平四年，令陝西系稅人戶家出一丁，號曰保毅，官給糧賜，使之分番戍守。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianping, it was ordered that each tax-registered household in Shaanxi provide one man, styled Baoyi; the government supplied grain and rewards, and had them rotate in garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianping, each tax-registered household in Shaanxi was required to furnish one man, called a Baoyi; the state issued grain and stipends and had them take turns on frontier garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 五年，陝西緣邊丁壯充保毅者至六萬八千七百七十五人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, able-bodied men along the Shaanxi frontier serving as Baoyi reached 68,775 persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the number of able-bodied men along the Shaanxi frontier enrolled as Baoyi reached 68,775.

sentences.zh: 七月，以募兵離去鄉土，有傷和氣，詔諸州點充強壯戶者，稅賦止令本州輸納，有司不得支移之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, because recruited soldiers leaving their native place harmed local harmony, an edict ordered that households selected as stalwart militia in the various prefectures should pay taxes only to their home prefecture; officials were not to shift collection elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, because recruiting soldiers away from home was thought to disturb local harmony, an edict ruled that households drafted as stalwart militia in each prefecture should pay taxes only within that prefecture, and officials were forbidden to redirect collection elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 先是，河北忠烈、宣勇無人承替者，雖老疾不得停籍。

translations.literal: Previously, in Hebei, Loyal Martyrs and Manifest Valor troops with no one to succeed them, though old or ill, could not be removed from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Previously in Hebei, men in the Loyal Martyrs and Manifest Valor corps who had no successor could not be struck from the rolls even when old or infirm.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔自今委無家業代替者，放令自便。

translations.literal: At this time, an edict ordered that from now on those with no household estate to provide a replacement should be released to do as they pleased.
translations.idiomatic: On this occasion an edict declared that hereafter men who truly lacked a household estate to supply a replacement might be discharged as they wished.

sentences.zh: 自是以至天禧間，並、代廣銳老病之兵，雖非親屬而願代者聽。

translations.literal: From this time until the Tianxi era, among the Broad Sharp troops of Bing and Dai, for old or sick soldiers, even if not kin, those willing to substitute were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: From then until the Tianxi era, among the Broad Sharp troops of Bing and Dai, substitutes were allowed for aged or sick soldiers even when not related, provided someone was willing to take their place.

sentences.zh: 河北強壯，恐奪其農時，則以十月至正月旬休日召集而教閱之。

translations.literal: For Hebei stalwart militia, fearing to seize their farming season, they were summoned and drilled on the ten-day rest days from the tenth month through the first month.
translations.idiomatic: For Hebei stalwart militia, to avoid disrupting the farming season, they were assembled and drilled only on the ten-day rest days between the tenth month and the first month.

sentences.zh: 忠烈、宣勇、廣銳之歸農而闕員者，並自京差補；

translations.literal: For Loyal Martyrs, Manifest Valor, and Broad Sharp troops who returned to farming and left vacancies, all were filled by dispatch from the capital;
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies left when Loyal Martyrs, Manifest Valor, or Broad Sharp men returned to farming were all filled by replacements dispatched from the capital;

sentences.zh: 戍於河上而歲月久遠者，則特爲遷補；

translations.literal: those garrisoning the river frontier for many years were specially transferred and replaced;
translations.idiomatic: those who had garrisoned the Yellow River frontier for many years were specially rotated and reassigned;

sentences.zh: 貧獨而無力召替者，則令逐處保明放停。

translations.literal: the poor and alone who lacked means to summon a substitute were ordered to be certified locally and discharged.
translations.idiomatic: and men who were poor and alone and could not afford to find a substitute were to be certified locally and released from service.

sentences.zh: 當是時，河北、河東有神銳、忠勇、強壯，河北有忠順、強人，陝西有保毅、砦戶、強人、強人弓手，河東、陝西有弓箭手，河北東、陝西有義勇，麟州有義兵，川陝有土丁、壯丁，荊湖南、北有弩手、土丁，廣南東、西有槍手、土丁，邕州有溪洞壯丁、土丁，廣南東、西有壯丁。

translations.literal: At that time, Hebei and Hedong had Shenrui, Loyal Valor, and stalwart militia; Hebei had Loyal Obedience and strong men; Shaanxi had Baoyi, stockade households, strong men, and strong-man bowmen; Hedong and Shaanxi had archers; eastern Hebei and Shaanxi had righteous volunteers; Lin Prefecture had righteous troops; Chuan-Shaan had native levies and sturdy youths; southern and northern Jinghu had crossbowmen and native levies; eastern and western Guangnan had spearmen and native levies; Yong Prefecture had stream-cave sturdy youths and native levies; eastern and western Guangnan had sturdy youths.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the empire fielded a patchwork of local forces: Shenrui, Loyal Valor, and stalwart militia in Hebei and Hedong; Loyal Obedience troops and scouts in Hebei; Baoyi, stockade households, scouts, and scout bowmen in Shaanxi; archers in Hedong and Shaanxi; righteous volunteers in eastern Hebei and Shaanxi; righteous troops at Lin; native and sturdy levies in Chuan-Shaan; crossbowmen and native levies in northern and southern Jinghu; spearmen and native levies in eastern and western Guangnan; stream-cave sturdy youths and native levies at Yong; and sturdy youths again in eastern and western Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 當仁宗時，神銳、忠勇、強壯久廢，忠順、保毅僅有存者。

translations.literal: At the time of Emperor Renzong, Shenrui, Loyal Valor, and stalwart militia had long been abolished; Loyal Obedience and Baoyi had only a few survivors.
translations.idiomatic: By Emperor Renzong's reign, Shenrui, Loyal Valor, and stalwart militia had long since lapsed, and only remnants of Loyal Obedience and Baoyi remained.

sentences.zh: 康定初，詔河北、河東添籍強壯，河北凡二十九萬三千，河東十四萬四千，皆以時訓練。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kangding, an edict ordered additional registration of stalwart militia in Hebei and Hedong: Hebei totaled 293,000, Hedong 144,000, all drilled on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kangding era, the court ordered fresh enrollment of stalwart militia in Hebei and Hedong—293,000 in Hebei and 144,000 in Hedong—all to be trained on a regular schedule.

sentences.zh: 自西師屢衄，正兵不足，乃籍陝西之民，三丁選一，以爲鄉弓手。

translations.literal: Since the western campaigns repeatedly suffered defeat and regular troops were insufficient, the people of Shaanxi were registered, one chosen from every three males, to serve as local bowmen.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated defeats in the western campaigns left the regular army short-handed, the state registered Shaanxi inhabitants, selecting one man from every three, as local bowmen.

sentences.zh: 未幾，刺充保捷，爲指揮一百八十五，分戍邊州。

translations.literal: Before long they were tattooed and enrolled as Baojie, forming 185 commands, distributed to garrison frontier prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they were branded and drafted into the Baojie corps as 185 commands, posted to garrison frontier prefectures.

sentences.zh: 西師罷，多揀放焉。

translations.literal: When the western campaigns ended, many were selected out and discharged.
translations.idiomatic: When the western war ended, most were screened out and released.

sentences.zh: 慶曆二年，籍河北強壯，得二十九萬五千，揀十之七爲義勇，且籍民丁以補其不足。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingli, stalwart militia in Hebei were registered, obtaining 295,000; seven-tenths were selected as righteous volunteers, and civilian males were also registered to make up the shortfall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qingli the state registered Hebei stalwart militia, mustering 295,000 men; seven-tenths were chosen as righteous volunteers, and additional civilian males were enrolled to fill the gaps.

sentences.zh: 河東揀籍如河北法。

translations.literal: Hedong selection and registration followed the Hebei method.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong applied the same selection and enrollment procedures as Hebei.

sentences.zh: 其後，議者論「義勇爲河北伏兵，以時講習，無待儲廩，得古寓兵于農之意。

translations.literal: Later, discussants argued: 'Righteous volunteers serve as Hebei's hidden troops; drilled on schedule, they need no stored grain, attaining the ancient idea of lodging troops among farmers.
translations.idiomatic: Later commentators argued: "Righteous volunteers are Hebei's hidden reserve: drilled on schedule, they require no state granaries and revive the ancient ideal of soldiers living among farmers.

sentences.zh: 惜其束於列郡，止以爲城守之備。

translations.literal: It is a pity they are bound to individual prefectures and used only as preparations for city defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they regretted that the men were tied to individual prefectures and used only for local garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 誠能令河北邢、冀二州分東西兩路，命二郡守分領，以時閱習，寇至，即兩路義勇翔集赴援，使其腹背受敵，則河北三十余所常伏銳兵矣」。

translations.literal: If truly Xing and Ji prefectures in Hebei could be divided into eastern and western routes, with two prefectural administrators each commanding, drilled on schedule, when bandits arrive both routes' righteous volunteers would swiftly gather to aid, making the enemy attacked front and rear—then Hebei's more than thirty districts would always have elite troops lying in wait.'
translations.idiomatic: If Xing and Ji in Hebei can be split into eastern and western commands under two prefects who drill them on schedule, invaders will find volunteers from both routes converging at once to strike front and rear; then more than thirty Hebei districts will always have elite troops in reserve."

sentences.zh: 朝廷下其議，河北帥臣李昭亮等議曰：「昔唐澤潞留後李抱真籍戶丁男，三選其一，農隙則分曹角射，歲終都試，以示賞罰，三年皆善射，舉部內得勁卒二萬。

translations.literal: The court transmitted this proposal for discussion; Hebei commander Li Zhaoliang and others argued: 'Formerly in Tang, Ze-Lu military commissioner Li Baozhen registered household males, selecting one from three; in farming intervals they were divided into groups for archery contests, and at year's end all were tested to show reward and punishment; within three years all were skilled archers, and within the circuit 20,000 crack troops were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The court circulated the proposal; Hebei commander Li Zhaoliang and others replied: 'In Tang times the Ze-Lu commissioner Li Baozhen enrolled household males, taking one in three; in slack farming seasons they drilled by squads in archery contests, and at year's end the whole force was tested for rewards and punishments. Within three years every man could shoot well, and the circuit fielded 20,000 crack troops.

sentences.zh: 既無廩費，府庫益實，乃繕甲兵爲戰具，遂雄視山東。

translations.literal: With no granary expense, the treasury grew fuller, and they then repaired armor and weapons as battle gear, dominating Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Without granary costs the treasury grew richer; they outfitted armor and weapons and came to dominate Shandong.

sentences.zh: 是時，天下稱昭義步兵冠于諸軍，此近代之顯效，而或謂民兵只可城守，難備戰陣，非通論也。

translations.literal: At that time the realm called Zhaoyi infantry foremost among all armies—this is a conspicuous recent effect—yet some say militia can only defend cities and are hard to deploy in battle lines; that is not a comprehensive view.
translations.idiomatic: All under Heaven then hailed the Zhaoyi infantry as the finest in the realm—a striking recent precedent—yet some still claim militia can only hold cities and cannot fight in the field; that is no universal rule.

sentences.zh: 但當無事時，便分義勇爲兩路，置官統領，以張用兵之勢，外使敵人疑而生謀，內亦搖動衆心，非計之得。

translations.literal: But to divide righteous volunteers into two routes in peacetime, appoint officials to command them, and thereby display military momentum—externally making enemies suspicious and scheming, internally also unsettling popular hearts—is not a winning plan.
translations.idiomatic: Yet to split the volunteers into two commands in peacetime, with officials over each, merely to display military might would invite enemy suspicion abroad and unsettle the people at home—not a sound plan.

sentences.zh: 姑令在所點集訓練，三二年間，武藝稍精，漸習行陣。

translations.literal: For now let them be mustered and trained in their locales; within two or three years their martial skills will grow somewhat refined and they will gradually learn field formations.
translations.idiomatic: For the present let each district muster and train them; in two or three years their skills will sharpen and they will gradually learn field maneuvers.

sentences.zh: 遇有警，得將臣如抱真者統馭，制其陣隊，示以賞罰，何敵不可戰哉？

translations.literal: When alarm arises, if a commander like Baozhen can lead them, control their formations, and display reward and punishment—what enemy could not be fought?
translations.idiomatic: When danger comes, put a commander like Baozhen in charge, set their formations, and enforce rewards and punishments—what foe could they not face?

sentences.zh: 至於部分佈列，量敵應機，系于臨時便宜，亦難預圖。

translations.literal: As for dividing units and arranging ranks, sizing up the enemy and responding to circumstances—this depends on timely expedients and is hard to plan in advance.
translations.idiomatic: As for deploying units, sizing up the enemy, and adapting on the spot—that must be left to commanders in the moment and cannot be charted beforehand.

sentences.zh: 況河北、河東皆邊州之地，自置義勇，州縣以時按閱，耳目已熟，行固無疑。」

translations.literal: Moreover Hebei and Hedong are all frontier prefectures; each establishes its own righteous volunteers, and prefectures and counties inspect them on schedule—their eyes and ears are already familiar, so movement naturally raises no doubt.'
translations.idiomatic: Besides, Hebei and Hedong are frontier regions where each prefecture maintains its own volunteers and county officials inspect them on schedule; commanders already know the men, so deployments raise no doubts.'

sentences.zh: 詔如所議。

translations.literal: An edict followed their discussion.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted their recommendation.

sentences.zh: 治平元年，宰相韓琦言：「古者籍民爲兵，數雖多而贍至薄。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhiping, Chief Councilor Han Qi said: 'In antiquity the people were registered as soldiers; though numerous, their support was extremely thin.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiping, Chief Councilor Han Qi said: "In antiquity civilians were registered as soldiers; though their numbers were vast, state support was meager.

sentences.zh: 唐置府兵，最爲近之，後廢不能復。

translations.literal: Tang established fubing, which came closest to this, but later abolished it and could not restore it.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang fubing system came closest to that ideal, yet once abolished it could never be revived.

sentences.zh: 今之義勇，河北幾十五萬，河東幾八萬，勇悍純實，出於天性，而有物力資產，父母妻子之所系，若稍加練簡，與唐府兵何異？

translations.literal: Today's righteous volunteers number nearly 150,000 in Hebei and nearly 80,000 in Hedong—fierce, sturdy, and sincere by nature, with material property and assets, parents, wives, and children to bind them; if slightly more drilled and selected, how do they differ from Tang fubing?
translations.idiomatic: Today's righteous volunteers number nearly 150,000 in Hebei and 80,000 in Hedong—fierce, honest men by nature, with farms, families, and property at stake; with a little more drilling, how would they differ from Tang fubing?

sentences.zh: 陝西嘗刺弓手爲保捷，河北、河東、陝西，皆控西北，事當一體。

translations.literal: Shaanxi once tattooed bowmen as Baojie; Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi all guard the northwest—the matter should be treated as one body.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi once branded bowmen into the Baojie corps; Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi all secure the northwest and ought to be handled as one system.

sentences.zh: 請于陝西諸州亦點義勇，止涅手背，一時不無小擾，終成長利。」

translations.literal: I request that righteous volunteers also be selected in Shaanxi prefectures, only tattooing the back of the hand; there will be some small disturbance for a time, but in the end lasting benefit will be achieved.'
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Shaanxi prefectures enroll righteous volunteers too, branding only the back of the hand; there will be brief local disruption, but lasting gain in the end."

sentences.zh: 天子納其言，乃遣籍陝西義勇，得十三萬八千四百六十五人。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven accepted his words and dispatched registration of Shaanxi righteous volunteers, obtaining 138,465 persons.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted his advice and ordered enrollment of Shaanxi righteous volunteers, mustering 138,465 men.

sentences.zh: 是時，諫官司馬光累奏，謂：「陝西頃嘗籍鄉弓手，始諭以不去鄉里。

translations.literal: At this time Remonstrance Official Sim Guang repeatedly memorialized, saying: 'Shaanxi recently registered local bowmen, initially informing them they would not leave their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Remonstrance Official Sim Guang repeatedly memorialized: "Shaanxi had just enrolled local bowmen after promising they would never leave home.

sentences.zh: 既而涅爲保捷正兵，遣戍邊州，其後不可用，遂汰爲民，徒使一路騷然，而于國無補。

translations.literal: Soon after they were tattooed as Baojie regular troops and sent to garrison frontier prefectures; later they proved unusable and were culled back to civilians, merely making the whole circuit turbulent while bringing no benefit to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Then they were branded as Baojie regulars and posted to frontier prefectures; later, found useless, they were discharged as civilians, throwing the whole circuit into turmoil with no gain for the state.

sentences.zh: 且祖宗平一海內，曷嘗有義勇哉？

translations.literal: Moreover when the ancestral emperors pacified all within the seas, when did they ever have righteous volunteers?
translations.idiomatic: Besides, when our founding emperors pacified the realm, did they ever rely on righteous volunteers?

sentences.zh: 自趙元昊反，諸將覆師相繼，終不能出一旅之衆，涉區脫之地。

translations.literal: Since Zhao Yuanhao rebelled, generals have suffered destroyed armies in succession, yet ultimately could not lead even one brigade across Qu-tuo territory.
translations.idiomatic: Since Zhao Yuanhao's rebellion, commanders have lost army after army, yet never led even a single brigade into Tangut territory.

sentences.zh: 當是時，三路鄉兵數十萬，何嘗得一人之力？

translations.literal: At that time the three circuits' local militia numbered several hundred thousand—when did they ever gain the strength of a single man?
translations.idiomatic: At that time the three circuits fielded hundreds of thousands of local militia—when did they contribute the strength of a single soldier?

sentences.zh: 議者必曰：'河北、河東不用衣廩，得勝兵數十萬，閱教精熟，皆可以戰；

translations.literal: Discussants will surely say: 'Hebei and Hedong need no clothing or granary support, obtaining several hundred thousand victorious troops, drilled to exquisite skill—all can fight;
translations.idiomatic: Advocates will surely say: 'Hebei and Hedong need no state rations, yet yield hundreds of thousands of crack troops drilled to perfection—all fit for battle;

sentences.zh: 又兵出民間，合于古制。

translations.literal: further, troops drawn from the people accord with ancient institutions.
translations.idiomatic: and soldiers drawn from the people match ancient practice.'

sentences.zh: '臣謂不然。

translations.literal: Your subject says this is not so.
translations.idiomatic: I say otherwise.

sentences.zh: 彼數十萬者，虛數也；

translations.literal: Those several hundred thousand are inflated numbers;
translations.idiomatic: Those hundreds of thousands are paper figures;

sentences.zh: 閱教精熟者，外貌也；

translations.literal: exquisite drilling is outward appearance;
translations.idiomatic: their flawless drills are mere show;

sentences.zh: 兵出民間者，名與古同而實異。

translations.literal: troops drawn from the people share the name with antiquity but differ in reality.
translations.idiomatic: and troops 'from the people' share the ancient label but not the ancient reality.

sentences.zh: 蓋州縣承朝廷之意，止求數多。

translations.literal: For prefectures and counties, carrying out the court's intent, seek only large numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties, obeying the court, chase head counts alone.

sentences.zh: 閱教之日，觀者但見其旗號鮮明，鉦鼓備具，行列有序，進退有節，莫不以爲真可以戰。

translations.literal: On drill days, spectators see only bright flags and banners, complete gongs and drums, ordered ranks, regulated advance and retreat—all think they can truly fight.
translations.idiomatic: On inspection days spectators see bright banners, full drums and gongs, neat ranks, and crisp maneuvers, and assume they are battle-ready.

sentences.zh: 殊不知彼猶聚戲，若遇敵，則瓦解星散，不知所之矣。

translations.literal: They do not know these are still like gathered play; if they meet the enemy, they dissolve and scatter like stars, not knowing where they go.
translations.idiomatic: They do not realize it is still pageantry; faced with the enemy they would scatter like stars, each man fleeing wherever he could.

sentences.zh: 古者兵出民間，耕桑所得，皆以衣食其家，故處則富足，出則精銳。

translations.literal: In antiquity when troops came from the people, farming and sericulture earnings all clothed and fed their families; thus at rest they were wealthy, in the field they were elite.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity soldiers lived on their own farming income, so at home they were prosperous and in the field they fought as elites.

sentences.zh: 今既賦斂農民粟帛以給正軍，又籍其身以爲兵，是一家而給二家之事也。

translations.literal: Now farmers' grain and silk are levied to supply regular troops, and their persons are also registered as soldiers—one household is made to support two households' affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Today farmers' grain and cloth feed the regular army while their bodies are enrolled as militia—one household is taxed to sustain two armies.

sentences.zh: 如此，民之財力安得不屈？

translations.literal: Thus, how can the people's wealth and strength fail to be bent and broken?
translations.idiomatic: How can popular wealth and strength fail to buckle under such a burden?

sentences.zh: 臣愚以爲河北、河東已刺之民，猶當放還，況陝西未刺之民乎？」

translations.literal: Your subject foolishly holds that the already tattooed people of Hebei and Hedong should still be released—how much more the yet untattooed people of Shaanxi?'
translations.idiomatic: I hold that even the already branded men of Hebei and Hedong ought to be sent home—how much more the unbranded people of Shaanxi?"

sentences.zh: 帝弗聽。

translations.literal: The emperor did not heed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 於是三路鄉兵，唯義勇爲最盛。

translations.literal: Thus among the three circuits' local militia, only righteous volunteers were most flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter among the three circuits' local forces, righteous volunteers alone flourished most.

sentences.zh: 熙甯以來，則尤重蕃兵、保甲之法，餘多承舊制。

translations.literal: From the Xining era onward, especially heavy weight was placed on tribal troops and the baojia system; the rest mostly followed old institutions.
translations.idiomatic: From the Xining reforms onward the court especially emphasized tribal auxiliaries and the baojia system, while most other arrangements followed earlier practice.

sentences.zh: 前史沿革，不復具述，取其有損益者著於篇。

translations.literal: Earlier historical evolution is not fully recounted here; what had gains or losses is set down in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier evolution is not rehearsed in full; only changes of real consequence are recorded here.

sentences.zh: 南渡而後，土宇雖不及前，而兵制多仍其故，凡其鄉兵、砦兵之可改者，皆附見焉。

translations.literal: After the southern crossing, though territory did not match the former extent, military institutions mostly kept their old forms; whatever changes were possible for local militia and stockade troops are appended here.
translations.idiomatic: After the court moved south, though territory shrank, military institutions largely persisted; relevant changes to local and stockade militia are noted in the sections below.

sentences.zh: 陝西保毅

translations.literal: Shaanxi Baoyi
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Baoyi Militia

sentences.zh: 陝西保毅開寶八年，發渭州平涼、潘原二縣民治城隍，因立爲保毅弓箭手，分戍鎮砦。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Baoyi: In the eighth year of Kaibao, people of Pingliang and Panyuan counties in Wei Prefecture were mobilized to repair city walls and moats, and thereby established as Baoyi archers, distributed to garrison forts and stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao 8 the state drafted men from Pingliang and Panyuan in Wei Prefecture to repair fortifications and enrolled them as Baoyi archers, posted to frontier forts and stockades.

sentences.zh: 能自置馬，免役。

translations.literal: Those able to provide their own horses were exempt from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Men who furnished their own horses were exempt from labor service.

sentences.zh: 逃、死，以親屬代，因周廣順舊制也。

translations.literal: Flight or death was replaced by kin, following the old Guangshun system of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Deserters and the dead were replaced by relatives, following the Later Zhou Guangshun precedent.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，秦州極邊止置千人，分番守戍。

translations.literal: Early in Xianping, on Qin's outer frontier only 1,000 were stationed, rotating in garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Xianping only 1,000 men were posted on Qin's outer frontier, serving in rotating shifts.

sentences.zh: 上番人月給米六斗，仲冬，賜指揮使至副都頭紫綾綿袍，十將以下皂綾袍。

translations.literal: Men on active rotation received six dou of grain monthly; in mid-winter, commanders down to deputy squad leaders were granted purple damask cotton robes, and squad leaders below received black damask robes.
translations.idiomatic: Active-duty men received six dou of grain per month; in mid-winter commanders through deputy squad leaders were given purple damask cotton robes and junior leaders black damask robes.

sentences.zh: 五年，點陝西沿邊丁壯充保毅，凡得六萬八千人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, able-bodied men along the Shaanxi frontier were selected as Baoyi, totaling 68,000.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the state drafted 68,000 able-bodied frontier men in Shaanxi as Baoyi.

sentences.zh: 給資糧，與正兵同戍邊郡。

translations.literal: Provisions were supplied, and together with regular troops they garrisoned frontier prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: They received rations and garrisoned frontier prefectures alongside regular troops.

sentences.zh: 慶曆初，詔悉刺爲保捷軍，唯秦州增置及三千人，環、慶、保安亦各籍置。

translations.literal: Early in Qingli, an edict ordered all tattooed as Baojie Army; only Qin added up to 3,000 men, and Huan, Qing, and Bao'an each also registered forces.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qingli an edict branded them all into the Baojie corps; Qin alone added 3,000 men, and Huan, Qing, and Bao'an each enrolled their own contingents.

sentences.zh: 是時，諸州總六千五百十八人，爲指揮三十一。

translations.literal: At that time the various prefectures totaled 6,518 men, forming 31 commands.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the prefectures together fielded 6,518 men in 31 commands.

sentences.zh: 皇祐五年，涇原都總管程戡上言：「陝西保毅，近歲止給役州縣，無復責以武技。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Huangyou, Jingyuan supreme commander Cheng Zhan memorialized: 'Shaanxi Baoyi in recent years are used only for corvée by prefectures and counties, no longer required for martial skill.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou 5 Jingyuan supreme commander Cheng Zhan reported: 'Shaanxi Baoyi lately serve only as corvée labor for local governments and are no longer drilled in arms.

sentences.zh: 自黥刺爲保捷，而家猶不免於保毅之籍，或折賣田產，而得產者以分數助役。

translations.literal: Since tattooing as Baojie, households still cannot escape Baoyi rolls; some sell off fields at a discount, and those who acquire the land assist with corvée by fractional shares.
translations.idiomatic: Even after branding as Baojie, families remain on Baoyi registers; some sell land cheaply, and buyers must share corvée duty in proportion.

sentences.zh: 今秦州僅三千人，久廢農業，請罷遣。」

translations.literal: Now Qin has only 3,000 men who have long abandoned farming—I request their abolition and discharge.'
translations.idiomatic: Qin now has only 3,000 men who have long neglected farming; I ask that the corps be abolished and the men released.'

sentences.zh: 詔自今敢私役者，計傭坐之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that from now on anyone daring to employ them privately would be punished according to hired-labor statutes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that anyone who privately impressed them into service would be punished under the statutes on unlawful hiring.

sentences.zh: 治平初，詔置保毅田承名額者，悉揀刺以爲義勇。

translations.literal: Early in Zhiping, an edict ordered that those holding Baoyi land-tenure name quotas should all be selected and tattooed as righteous volunteers.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhiping holders of Baoyi land quotas were all selected and branded as righteous volunteers.

sentences.zh: 熙寧四年，詔廢其軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xining, an edict abolished this army.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 4 the court abolished the corps.

sentences.zh: 環慶砦戶、強人弓手，九年，詔如禁軍法，上其籍，隸于馬軍司，廩給視中禁軍。

translations.literal: Huan-Qing stockade households and strong-man bowmen: In the ninth year, an edict ordered them treated like forbidden troops—submitting their rolls, subordinated to the Horse Army Directorate, with granary support equal to middle forbidden troops.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 stockade households and scout bowmen of Huan and Qing were ordered to follow forbidden-army rules, report their rolls to the Horse Army Directorate, and receive rations equal to middle-grade palace troops.

sentences.zh: 河北忠順

translations.literal: Hebei Loyal Obedience
translations.idiomatic: Hebei Loyal Obedience Troops

sentences.zh: 河北忠順自太宗朝以瀛、莫、雄、霸州、乾甯、順安、保定軍置忠順，凡三千人，分番巡徼，隸沿邊戰棹巡檢司。

translations.literal: Hebei Loyal Obedience: From Emperor Taizong's reign, Loyal Obedience was established in Ying, Mo, Xiong, Ba prefectures, Qianning, Shun'an, and Baoding Army—3,000 men total, rotating in patrol, subordinate to the frontier war-boat patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: From Taizong's reign Loyal Obedience corps of 3,000 were raised in Ying, Mo, Xiong, Ba, Qianning, Shun'an, and Baoding, rotating on patrol under the frontier war-boat patrol office.

sentences.zh: 自十月悉上，人給糧二升，至二月輪半營農。

translations.literal: From the tenth month all went on duty; each man received two sheng of grain, until the second month when half rotated back to farm.
translations.idiomatic: From the tenth month all reported for duty with two sheng of grain per man until the second month, when half the men rotated home to farm.

sentences.zh: 慶曆七年，夏竦建議與正兵參戍。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qingli, Xia Song proposed joint garrison with regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingli 7 Xia Song proposed posting them alongside regular troops.

sentences.zh: 八年，以水沴，多逋亡者，權益正兵代其闕額。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because of flood damage, many fled; regular troops were temporarily increased to fill their vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year floods drove many to desert, and regular troops temporarily filled the gaps.

sentences.zh: 皇祐四年，權放業農，後不復補。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Huangyou, they were temporarily released to farm, and afterward were not replenished.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou 4 they were temporarily sent back to farming and never refilled.

sentences.zh: 河北陝西強人砦戶

translations.literal: Hebei-Shaanxi Strong Men and Stockade Households
translations.idiomatic: Hebei and Shaanxi Scouts and Stockade Households

sentences.zh: 河北陝西強人、砦戶、強人弓手名號不一。

translations.literal: Hebei-Shaanxi strong men, stockade households, and strong-man bowmen had varying titles.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts, stockade households, and scout bowmen in Hebei and Shaanxi went under various names.

sentences.zh: 咸平四年，募河北民諳契丹道路、勇銳可爲間伺者充強人，置都頭、指揮使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianping, Hebei people familiar with Khitan routes and brave enough for reconnaissance were recruited as strong men, with chief heads and commanders appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 4 the state recruited Hebei men who knew Khitan routes and were bold enough for scouting, appointing squad chiefs and commanders.

sentences.zh: 無事散處田野，寇至追集，給器甲、口糧、食錢，遣出塞偷斫賊壘，能斬首級、奪馬者如賞格。

translations.literal: In peace they were scattered in fields; when bandits came they were summoned, given armor, rations, and food money, and sent beyond the border to raid enemy camps stealthily; those who could take heads or seize horses received rewards per the bounty schedule.
translations.idiomatic: In peacetime they lived scattered in the countryside; when raiders came they were called up, issued arms, rations, and pay, and sent across the border to strike enemy camps; head counts and captured horses were rewarded on the bounty scale.

sentences.zh: 虜獲財畜皆畀之。

translations.literal: Enemy goods and livestock seized were all given to them.
translations.idiomatic: All enemy goods and livestock they captured were theirs to keep.

sentences.zh: 慶曆二年，環州亦募，涅手背，自備戎械並馬，置押官、甲頭、隊長，戶四等以下免役，上番防守，月給奉廩。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingli, Huan Prefecture also recruited them, tattooing the back of the hand; they provided their own weapons and horses; supervising officers, squad heads, and team leaders were appointed; households of the fourth rank and below were exempt from corvée; on rotation they defended, with monthly salary granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingli 2 Huan Prefecture enrolled them too, branding the back of the hand; men supplied arms and horses; officers, squad heads, and team leaders were appointed; households of the fourth rank or lower were exempt from corvée; on active duty they garrisoned the frontier with monthly stipends.

sentences.zh: 三年，涇原路被邊城砦悉置。

translations.literal: In the third year, all frontier cities and stockades of the Jingyuan circuit were fully established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year every frontier city and stockade on the Jingyuan circuit had them in place.

sentences.zh: 環、慶二州復有砦戶，康定中，以沿邊弓手涅手背充，有警召集防戍，與保毅弓手同。

translations.literal: Huan and Qing prefectures again had stockade households; in Kangding, frontier bowmen with tattooed backs of the hand filled the posts; when alarm arose they were summoned to defend, the same as Baoyi archers.
translations.idiomatic: Huan and Qing also fielded stockade households; in Kangding frontier bowmen were branded on the hand and called up when alarms sounded, like the Baoyi archers.

sentences.zh: 大順城、西谷砦有強人弓手，天禧、慶曆間募置，番戍爲巡徼斥候，日給糧。

translations.literal: Dashun City and Xigu Stockade had strong-man bowmen, recruited between Tianxi and Qingli, rotating garrison as patrol scouts, with daily grain.
translations.idiomatic: Dashun City and Xigu Stockade had scout bowmen recruited between Tianxi and Qingli who rotated as frontier scouts with a daily grain ration.

sentences.zh: 人賦田八十畝，能自備馬者益賦四十畝。

translations.literal: Each man was allotted eighty mu of fields; those able to provide their own horses received an additional forty mu.
translations.idiomatic: Each man was granted eighty mu of land; those who furnished their own horses received forty mu more.

sentences.zh: 遇防秋，官給器甲，下番隨軍訓練。

translations.literal: When autumn defense came, the government supplied armor; off rotation they trained with the army.
translations.idiomatic: During the autumn defense season the state issued armor, and between rotations they drilled with the army.

sentences.zh: 爲指揮六。

translations.literal: They formed six commands.
translations.idiomatic: They were organized into six commands.

sentences.zh: 河北河東強壯

translations.literal: Hebei-Hedong Stalwart Militia
translations.idiomatic: Hebei and Hedong Stalwart Militia

sentences.zh: 河北、河東強壯五代時，瀛、霸諸州已置。

translations.literal: Hebei-Hedong stalwart militia: In the Five Dynasties era, Ying, Ba, and other prefectures already had them established.
translations.idiomatic: Stalwart militia in Hebei and Hedong dated to the Five Dynasties, when Ying, Ba, and other prefectures first raised them.

sentences.zh: 咸平三年，詔河北家二丁、三丁籍一，四丁、五丁籍二，六丁、七丁籍三，八丁以上籍四，爲強壯。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianping, an edict ordered that in Hebei households with two or three males register one, with four or five register two, with six or seven register three, with eight or more register four, as stalwart militia.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 3 the court ordered Hebei households to enroll stalwart militia by male count: one man from households of two or three sons, two from four or five, three from six or seven, and four from eight or more.

sentences.zh: 五百人爲指揮，置指揮使；

translations.literal: Five hundred men formed a command, with a commander appointed;
translations.idiomatic: Every five hundred men formed a command under a commander;

sentences.zh: 百人爲都，置正、副都頭二人、節級四人。

translations.literal: one hundred men formed a company, with chief and deputy company heads and four rank officers.
translations.idiomatic: every hundred formed a company with chief and deputy heads and four rank officers.

sentences.zh: 所在置籍，擇善騎射者第補校長，聽自置馬，勝甲者蠲其戶役。

translations.literal: Registers were kept in each locality; skilled riders and archers were ranked and appointed squad leaders; they were permitted to provide their own horses; those excelling in armor were exempted from household corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Each district kept rolls, promoting skilled riders and archers as squad leaders; men who supplied their own horses were allowed to do so, and the best armored fighters were exempt from household corvée.

sentences.zh: 五年，募其勇敢，團結附大軍爲柵，官給鎧甲。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the brave were recruited, organized and attached to the main army as palisade troops, with armor supplied by the government.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the brave were recruited, grouped as palisade auxiliaries to the main army, and issued government armor.

sentences.zh: 景德元年，遣使分詣河北、河東集強壯，借庫兵給糧訓練，非緣邊即分番迭教，寇至悉集守城，寇退營農。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingde, envoys were dispatched separately to Hebei and Hedong to assemble stalwart militia; arsenal weapons were borrowed and grain given for training; where not on the frontier they drilled in rotating shifts; when bandits came all were gathered to defend cities; when bandits retreated they returned to farming.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 1 envoys were sent to Hebei and Hedong to muster stalwart militia, issue arsenal arms and grain for training, drill interior districts in rotating shifts, mass everyone for city defense when raiders came, and send them back to the fields when raiders withdrew.

sentences.zh: 至康定初，州縣不復閱習，其籍多亡。

translations.literal: By early Kangding, prefectures and counties no longer inspected drills, and most rolls were lost.
translations.idiomatic: By early Kangding local governments had stopped inspecting drills and most rolls were lost.

sentences.zh: 乃詔二路選補，增其數，爲伍保，迭糾遊惰及作奸者。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered selection and replenishment in both circuits, increasing their numbers, forming five-man mutual-security groups to take turns reporting idlers and wrongdoers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered both circuits to refill the ranks, increase numbers, and form five-man mutual-security groups to report idlers and criminals.

sentences.zh: 二十五人爲團，置押官；

translations.literal: Twenty-five men formed a platoon, with a supervising officer;
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five men formed a platoon under a supervising officer;

sentences.zh: 四團爲都，置正、副都頭各一人；

translations.literal: four platoons formed a company, with one chief and one deputy company head;
translations.idiomatic: four platoons formed a company with chief and deputy heads;

sentences.zh: 五都爲指揮，置指揮使，各以階級伏事。

translations.literal: five companies formed a command, with a commander appointed; each served according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: five companies formed a command under a commander, with rank determining subordination.

sentences.zh: 年二十系籍，六十免，取家人或他戶代之。

translations.literal: At age twenty they were entered on the rolls, at sixty exempted; family members or other households were taken as replacements.
translations.idiomatic: Men entered the rolls at twenty and left at sixty, replaced by relatives or other households.

sentences.zh: 歲正月，縣以籍上州，州以籍奏兵部，按舉不如法者。

translations.literal: Each year in the first month counties submitted rolls to prefectures, prefectures reported rolls to the Ministry of War, and those not conforming to regulations were investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Each first month counties forwarded rolls to prefectures, prefectures reported to the Ministry of War, and violators were prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 慶曆二年，悉揀以爲義勇，不預者釋之，而存其籍，以備守葺城池。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingli, all were selected to become righteous volunteers; those not chosen were released, but their rolls were kept for defending and repairing city walls.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingli 2 all were screened for righteous volunteer service; men not selected were released but kept on the rolls for wall repair and garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 而河東強壯自此浸廢矣。

translations.literal: Hedong stalwart militia from this time gradually fell into disuse.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong stalwart militia thereafter gradually lapsed.

sentences.zh: 其募于河北者，舊給塘泊河淤之田，力不足以耕，重苦番教，應募者寡。

translations.literal: Those recruited in Hebei were formerly given pond and river-silt fields; their strength was insufficient to farm them, and they were heavily burdened by rotating drills, so few responded to recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei recruits had been given pond and river-silt land they could not farm, and the burden of rotating drills made few men volunteer.

sentences.zh: 熙寧七年罷之，以其田募民耕，戶兩頃，蠲其賦，以爲保甲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xining this was abolished; the land was used to recruit civilians to farm, two qing per household, their taxes remitted, for baojia use.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 7 the system was abolished; the land was rented to farmers at two qing per household with tax remission for the baojia system.

sentences.zh: 河東陝西弓箭手

translations.literal: Hedong-Shaanxi Archers
translations.idiomatic: Hedong and Shaanxi Frontier Archers

sentences.zh: 河東、陝西弓箭手周廣順初，鎮州諸縣，十戶取材勇者一人爲之，餘九戶資以器甲芻糧。

translations.literal: Hedong-Shaanxi archers: Early in Later Zhou Guangshun, in Zhen Prefecture counties, from ten households one brave man was chosen, the other nine households supplying arms, armor, fodder, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong and Shaanxi frontier archers began in Later Zhou Guangshun, when Zhen Prefecture drafted one brave man from every ten households while the other nine supplied arms, armor, fodder, and grain.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年，詔釋之，凡一千四百人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianlong, an edict released them—1,400 men in all.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianlong 2 an edict discharged all 1,400 of them.

sentences.zh: 景德二年，鎮戎軍曹瑋言：「有邊民應募爲弓箭手者，請給以閒田，蠲其徭賦，有警，可參正兵爲前鋒，而官無資糧戎械之費。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingde, Zhenrong Army commander Cao Wei said: 'Border people who volunteer as archers should be given idle fields and exempted from corvée and taxes; when alarm arises they can join regular troops as vanguard, while the government bears no cost for provisions or weapons.'
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 2 Zhenrong commander Cao Wei said: "If border people volunteer to become archers, I request that they be given idle land and exempted from corvee and levies; when alarms sound, they can join the regular troops as vanguard, while the state bears no cost for rations, arms, or armor."

sentences.zh: 詔：「人給田二頃，出甲士一人，及三頃者出戰馬一匹。

translations.literal: An edict ordered: 'Each man is given two qing of fields, furnishing one armored soldier; those with three qing furnish one war horse.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Each man shall receive two qing of land and furnish one armored soldier; holders of three qing shall also furnish one war horse.

sentences.zh: 設堡戍，列部伍，補指揮使以下，據兵有功勞者，亦補軍都指揮使，置巡檢以統之。」

translations.literal: Forts were established, units arrayed, commanders and below appointed; according to military merit some were also appointed army commanders, and patrol inspectors were set up to command them.'
translations.idiomatic: Forts shall be built, units organized, officers appointed through commander rank; those with military merit may also be appointed army commander, and patrol inspectors shall be placed over them."

sentences.zh: 其後，鄜延、環慶、涇原並河東州軍亦各募置。

translations.literal: Afterward, Fuyan, Huan-Qing, Jingyuan, and Hedong prefectural armies each also recruited and established them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Fuyan, Huan-Qing, Jingyuan, and Hedong circuits each raised their own archer corps.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，諸路總三萬二千四百七十四人，爲指揮一百九十二。

translations.literal: During Qingli, the various circuits totaled 32,474 men, forming 192 commands.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingli era the circuits together fielded 32,474 archers in 192 commands.

sentences.zh: 是時，河東都轉運使歐陽修言：「代州、岢嵐、寧化、火山軍被邊地幾二三萬頃，請募人墾種，充弓箭手。」

translations.literal: At this time Hedong transport commissioner Ouyang Xiu said: 'The frontier lands of Dai, Kelan, Ninghua, and Huoshan Armies amount to nearly twenty or thirty thousand qing—please recruit people to reclaim and farm them as archers.'
translations.idiomatic: At this time Hedong transport commissioner Ouyang Xiu said: "Dai Prefecture, Kelan, Ninghua, and Huoshan Army have nearly twenty or thirty thousand qing of frontier land; I request that people be recruited to cultivate it and serve as archers."

sentences.zh: 詔宣撫使范仲淹議，以爲便。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Pacification Commissioner Fan Zhongyan to discuss it; he deemed it expedient.
translations.idiomatic: The court referred the plan to Pacification Commissioner Fan Zhongyan, who approved it.

sentences.zh: 遂以岢嵐軍北草城川禁地募人拒敵界十里外占耕，得二千餘戶，歲輸租數萬斛，自備弓馬，涅手背爲弓箭手。

translations.literal: Thereupon in the forbidden land of Caocheng River north of Kelan Army, people were recruited to farm ten li beyond the enemy border, obtaining more than 2,000 households who paid tens of thousands of hu in annual rent, provided their own bows and horses, and were tattooed on the back of the hand as archers.
translations.idiomatic: Settlers were then recruited to farm forbidden land at Caocheng River north of Kelan, ten li beyond the enemy border; more than 2,000 households paid tens of thousands of hu in rent yearly, supplied their own bows and horses, and were branded on the hand as archers.

sentences.zh: 既以并州明鎬沮議而止。

translations.literal: Soon after it was stopped because Bing Prefecture's Ming Hao obstructed the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The scheme was soon halted when Bing Prefecture's Ming Hao blocked it.

sentences.zh: 至和二年，韓琦奏訂鎬議非是，曰：「昔潘美患契丹數入寇，遂驅旁邊耕民內徙，苟免一時失備之咎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhihe, Han Qi memorialized that Ming Hao's view was wrong, saying: 'Formerly Pan Mei, troubled by repeated Khitan raids, drove nearby farming people to move inward, merely to escape blame for a moment's lapse in defense.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhihe 2 Han Qi argued that Ming Hao was mistaken: 'When Pan Mei, troubled by repeated Khitan raids, drove frontier farmers inland, he only avoided blame for a momentary lapse in defense.

sentences.zh: 其後契丹講和，因循不復許人復業，遂名禁地，歲久爲戎人侵耕，漸失疆界。

translations.literal: Later the Khitan made peace, but by inertia people were not allowed to resume farming; it was named forbidden land; over years foreigners encroached to farm it, and borders were gradually lost.
translations.idiomatic: After peace with the Khitan the court never let them return; the land became forbidden territory, and over time foreign peoples farmed it until the border itself eroded.

sentences.zh: 今代州、寧化軍有禁地萬頃，請如草城川募弓箭手，可得四千餘戶。」

translations.literal: Now Dai Prefecture and Ninghua Army have ten thousand qing of forbidden land—please recruit archers as at Caocheng River, and more than 4,000 households can be obtained.'
translations.idiomatic: Today Dai and Ninghua still hold ten thousand qing of forbidden land; recruiting archers as at Caocheng River could yield more than 4,000 households.'

sentences.zh: 下并州富弼議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to Bing Prefecture's Fu Bi for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was referred to Fu Bi in Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 弼請如琦奏。

translations.literal: Bi requested to follow Qi's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Bi endorsed Han Qi's plan.

sentences.zh: 詔具爲條，視山坡川原均給，人二頃；

translations.literal: An edict ordered detailed regulations: allotting according to hillside, stream, or plain, two qing per man;
translations.idiomatic: An edict laid down rules: land was allotted by terrain at two qing per man;

sentences.zh: 其租秋一輸，川地畝五升，阪原地畝三升，毋折變科徭。

translations.literal: rent paid once in autumn—five sheng per mu for stream land, three sheng per mu for slope and plain land—with no conversion or additional corvée.
translations.idiomatic: with a single autumn payment of five sheng per mu on valley land and three on slopes and plains, and no added corvée conversions.

sentences.zh: 仍指揮即山險爲屋，以便居止，備征防，無得擅役。

translations.literal: They were also directed to build houses on mountainous defiles for convenient dwelling, prepared for campaigns and defense, and were not to be impressed for unauthorized corvée.
translations.idiomatic: They were to build houses on defensible heights, remain ready for campaigns, and not be impressed for unauthorized labor.

sentences.zh: 先是，麟、府、豐州亦以閒田募置，人給屋，貸口糧二石，而德順軍靜邊砦壕外弓箭手尤爲勁勇。

translations.literal: Previously Lin, Fu, and Feng prefectures also recruited them with idle land, each man given a house and loaned two shi of rations; the archers outside the moat at Jingbian Stockade in Deshun Army were especially fierce and brave.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Lin, Fu, and Feng had recruited archers on idle land, granting houses and two shi of grain loans; the archers beyond the moat at Jingbian Stockade in Deshun were especially formidable.

sentences.zh: 夏人利其地，數來爭占，朝廷爲築堡戍守。

translations.literal: The Tanguts coveted the land and repeatedly came to seize it; the court built forts to garrison and defend.
translations.idiomatic: The Tanguts coveted the land and repeatedly encroached, so the court built forts to hold it.

sentences.zh: 至治平末，河東七州軍弓箭手總七千五百人，陝西十州軍並砦戶總四萬六千三百人。

translations.literal: By the end of Zhiping, Hedong's seven prefectures and armies totaled 7,500 archers; Shaanxi's ten prefectures and armies with stockade households totaled 46,300.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of Zhiping Hedong's seven prefectures and armies fielded 7,500 archers, and Shaanxi's ten prefectures and armies with stockade households 46,300.

sentences.zh: 先是，康定元年，詔麟、府州募歸業人增補義軍，俾耕本戶故地而免其稅租。

translations.literal: Previously in the first year of Kangding, an edict ordered Lin and Fu to recruit returned farmers to supplement the righteous army, letting them farm their original household lands while exempting taxes and rent.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in Kangding 1, Lin and Fu were ordered to recruit returned farmers into the righteous army, letting them farm their old lands tax-free.

sentences.zh: 其制與弓箭手略同，而不給田。

translations.literal: Its system was roughly the same as archers, but no land was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The system resembled that of archers but without land grants.

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年，兵部上河東七郡舊籍七千五、今籍七千，陝西十郡並砦戶舊籍四萬六千三百，今唯秦鳳有砦戶。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xining, the Ministry of War reported Hedong's seven prefectures: old rolls 7,500, present rolls 7,000; Shaanxi's ten prefectures with stockade households: old rolls 46,300, now only Qinfeng has stockade households.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 2 the Ministry of War reported Hedong's seven prefectures at 7,000 men on the rolls versus 7,500 formerly, and Shaanxi's ten prefectures down from 46,300 archers and stockade households to stockade households in Qinfeng alone.

sentences.zh: 三年，秦鳳路經略使李師中言：「前年築熟羊等堡，募蕃部獻地，置弓箭手。

translations.literal: In the third year, Qinfeng circuit commissioner Li Shizhong said: 'The year before last we built Shuyang and other forts, recruited tribal people to offer land, and established archers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Qinfeng commissioner Li Shizhong reported: 'Two years ago we built Shuyang and other forts, accepted tribal land grants, and enrolled archers.

sentences.zh: 迄今三年，所募非良民，初未嘗團結訓練，竭力田事。

translations.literal: For three years now those recruited have not been good people; from the start they were never organized and trained, nor have they devoted themselves to farming.
translations.idiomatic: Three years on, the recruits have been poor subjects, never organized or drilled and never devoted to farming.

sentences.zh: 今當置屯列堡，爲戰守計。

translations.literal: Now we should establish agricultural colonies and line forts for plans of fighting and defense.
translations.idiomatic: We should now establish farm colonies and a chain of forts for defense and offense.

sentences.zh: 置屯之法，百人爲屯，授田於旁塞堡，將校領農事，休即教武技。

translations.literal: The method for colonies: one hundred men form a colony; fields are granted beside nearby frontier forts; officers lead farming; in rest periods they are taught martial skills.
translations.idiomatic: Colonies would comprise one hundred men each, granted land beside frontier forts; officers would supervise farming and drill martial skills in off seasons.

sentences.zh: 其牛具、農器、旗鼓之屬並官予。

translations.literal: Oxen, implements, farm tools, flags, drums, and the like were all supplied by the government.
translations.idiomatic: Oxen, tools, farm implements, flags, and drums would all be state-issued.

sentences.zh: 置堡之法，諸屯並力，自近及遠築爲堡以備寇至，寇退則悉出掩擊。」

translations.literal: The method for forts: all colonies combine strength, building forts from near to far to prepare for bandits' arrival; when bandits retreat all sally forth for ambush strikes.'
translations.idiomatic: Forts would be built jointly from near to far; when raiders came the colonists would shelter in them, and when raiders withdrew they would sally out in ambush.'

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 五年，趙禼爲鄜延路，以其地萬五千九百頃，募漢、蕃弓箭手四千九百人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Zhao Xu served on the Fuyan circuit and, with 15,900 qing of its land, recruited 4,900 Han and tribal archers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Zhao Xu on the Fuyan circuit used 15,900 qing of land to recruit 4,900 Han and tribal archers.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其能省募兵之費，褒賞之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his ability to economize on recruited-troop expenses and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his savings on recruitment costs and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 六年，禼言新募弓箭手頗習武技，請更番代正兵歸京師。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Xu said the newly recruited archers were fairly skilled in martial arts and requested rotating them to replace regular troops returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Xu reported that the new archers were well drilled and asked to rotate them in place of regulars sent back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔審度之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered a review.

sentences.zh: 十月，詔熙河路以公田募弓箭手，其旁塞民強勇願自占田，出租賦，聯保伍，或義勇願應募，或民戶願受蕃部地者聽。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, an edict ordered the Xihe circuit to use public fields to recruit archers; frontier people who were strong and brave and wished to claim land themselves, paying rent and taxes and joining mutual-security groups, or righteous volunteers wishing to enlist, or civilian households willing to receive tribal land—all were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Xihe circuit was ordered to recruit archers on public land; brave frontier settlers who claimed land and paid taxes, joined mutual-security groups, volunteered as righteous militia, or accepted tribal land were all allowed to enroll.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，帶禦器械王中正詣熙河路，以土田募弓箭手。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, Bearer of Imperial Arms Wang Zhongzheng went to the Xihe circuit to recruit archers with land grants.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year Bearer of Imperial Arms Wang Zhongzheng went to Xihe to recruit archers with land grants.

sentences.zh: 所募人毋拘路分遠近，不依常格，差官召募，仍親提舉。

translations.literal: Recruits were not bound by circuit distance or usual regulations; officials were dispatched to recruit, and he personally supervised.
translations.idiomatic: Recruits were not limited by circuit boundaries or usual quotas; officials were dispatched to enroll them under his personal supervision.

sentences.zh: 三月，王韶言：「河州近城川地招漢弓箭手外，其山坡地招蕃弓箭手，人給地一頃，蕃官兩頃，大蕃官三頃。

translations.literal: In the third month, Wang Shao said: 'Besides recruiting Han archers on the near-city stream lands of He Prefecture, on hillside lands recruit tribal archers—one qing per man, two qing for tribal officers, three qing for senior tribal officers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Wang Shao said: "Besides recruiting Han archers on He Prefecture's lowland near the city, tribal archers should be recruited on the slopes, with one qing of land per man, two for tribal officers, and three for senior tribal officers.

sentences.zh: 仍募漢弓箭手等爲甲頭，候招及人數，補節級人員，與蕃官同管勾。

translations.literal: Han archers were also recruited as squad heads; when recruitment reached the required number, rank officers were appointed to administer jointly with tribal officers.
translations.idiomatic: Han archers would serve as squad heads, and once quotas were met rank officers would be appointed to administer them jointly with tribal officers.

sentences.zh: 自來出軍，多爲漢兵盜殺蕃兵，以爲首功。

translations.literal: Whenever troops went out, Han soldiers often secretly killed tribal soldiers to claim head rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign Han soldiers had often killed tribal auxiliaries in secret to claim head rewards.

sentences.zh: 今蕃兵各願于左耳前刺'蕃兵'字。」

translations.literal: Now tribal soldiers each wish to tattoo the characters 'tribal soldier' before the left ear.'
translations.idiomatic: Tribal soldiers now asked to tattoo the words 'tribal soldier' before the left ear.'

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，中書條例司乞五路弓箭手、砦戶，除防拓、巡警及緩急事許差發外，若修城諸役，即申經略安撫、鈐轄司。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Central Secretariat Regulations Office requested that for archers and stockade households in the five circuits, aside from frontier defense, patrol, and urgent matters permitting dispatch, if used for wall repair and other labor they must report to the pacification and military control offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Central Secretariat Regulations Office ruled that archers and stockade households in the five circuits could be dispatched only for frontier defense, patrol, and emergencies; other tasks such as wall repair required approval from pacification and military control offices.

sentences.zh: 其有擅差發及科配、和雇者，並科違制之罪。

translations.literal: Those who unauthorizedly dispatched them or imposed requisitions and hired labor were all punished for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Unauthorized dispatch, requisition, or hired labor would be punished as a regulatory violation.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 其夔州路義軍、廣南槍手土丁峒丁、湖南弩手、福建鄉丁槍手，依此法。

translations.literal: The righteous armies of Kuizhou circuit, spearmen and native and cave levies of Guangnan, crossbowmen of Hunan, and local spearmen of Fujian followed this law.
translations.idiomatic: The same rules applied to Kuizhou righteous troops, Guangnan spearmen and native and cave levies, Hunan crossbowmen, and Fujian local spearmen.

sentences.zh: 八年，詔涇原路七駐泊就糧上下番正兵、弓箭手、蕃兵約七萬餘人分爲五將，別置熙河策應將副。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, an edict ordered Jingyuan circuit's seven grain-stationed garrisons' rotating regular troops, archers, and tribal soldiers—about 70,000—divided into five commands, with a separate Xihe support deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Jingyuan's roughly 70,000 rotating regulars, archers, and tribal troops at seven grain stations were divided into five commands, with a separate Xihe support deputy.

sentences.zh: 十年，知延州呂惠卿言：「自熙寧五年，招到弓箭手，只是權行差補，未曾團定指揮。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Yan Prefecture prefect Lü Huiqing said: 'Since the fifth year of Xining, recruited archers have only been temporarily assigned and supplemented; commands have never been fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Yan Prefecture prefect Lu Huiqing said: "Since Xining 5 the archers recruited have only been temporarily filled into posts and have not yet been organized into fixed commands.

sentences.zh: 本司見將本路團結將分團成指揮都分，置立將校統轄，即于臨時易爲勾集。」

translations.literal: This office now proposes to take the circuit's organized commands, divide them into command sections, appoint officers to command them, so that at need they can easily be mustered.'
translations.idiomatic: This office now intends to organize the circuit into command sections under officers, so they can be mustered easily when needed."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 元豐二年，計議措置邊防所言，以涇原路正兵、漢蕃弓箭手爲十一將，分駐諸州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanfeng, the Border Defense Planning Office proposed forming Jingyuan's regular troops and Han and tribal archers into eleven commands, stationed separately in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanfeng the Border Defense Planning Office proposed organizing Jingyuan's regulars and Han and tribal archers into eleven commands posted across the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔：「凡弓箭手兵騎各以五十人爲隊，置引戰、旗頭、左右傔旗，及以本屬酋首將校爲擁隊，並如正軍法。

translations.literal: In the third year, an edict ordered: 'All archer infantry and cavalry shall form fifty-man squads, with battle-leaders, standard-bearers, left and right flank guards, and tribal chiefs and officers as escort squads—all following regular army law.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year an edict said: "Archer infantry and cavalry shall each be formed into fifty-man squads, with battle-leaders, standard-bearers, left and right banner aides, and chiefs and officers of their own groups as squad escorts, all according to regular army law.

sentences.zh: 蕃捉生、蕃敢勇、山河戶亦如之。

translations.literal: Tribal scouts, tribal dare-to-be-brave, and mountain-river households were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal scouts, tribal dare-to-dies, and mountain-river households followed the same rules.

sentences.zh: 凡募弓箭手、蕃捉生、強人、山河戶，不以等樣，第募有保任、年十七已上、弓射七斗、任負帶者。

translations.literal: For recruiting archers, tribal scouts, strong men, and mountain-river households, regardless of status, only those with guarantors, age seventeen or above, shooting seven dou with the bow, and able to bear armor and belt were recruited.
translations.idiomatic: Recruits for archers, tribal scouts, strong men, and mountain-river households were chosen regardless of status, provided they had guarantors, were at least seventeen, could shoot seven dou, and could bear armor.

sentences.zh: 鄜延路新舊蕃捉生、環慶路強人、諸路漢弓箭手、鄜延路歸明界保毅蕃戶弓箭手，皆涅於手背。」

translations.literal: New and old tribal scouts of Fuyan, strong men of Huan-Qing, Han archers of the various circuits, and Fuyan returned-submission-border Baoyi tribal-household archers were all tattooed on the back of the hand.'
translations.idiomatic: Fuyan's old and new tribal scouts, Huan-Qing strong men, Han archers on every circuit, and Fuyan's returned-submission-border tribal-household archers were all branded on the hand.'

sentences.zh: 四年，涇原路經略司言：「本路弓箭手闕地九千七百頃，渭州隴山一帶川原陂地四千餘頃，可募弓箭手二千餘人，或不願應募，乞收其地入官。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Jingyuan commissioner said: 'This circuit's archers lack 9,700 qing of land; along Long Mountain in Wei Prefecture there are more than 4,000 qing of stream, plain, and slope land where more than 2,000 archers could be recruited—or if none wish to enlist, please take the land into government ownership.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Jingyuan reported: "This circuit has 9,700 qing of archer land still vacant, and the river plains and slopes along Long Mountain in Wei Prefecture have more than 4,000 qing where over 2,000 archers can be recruited. If people are unwilling to enlist, we request that the land be taken into state possession."

sentences.zh: 熙河路都大經制司言；

translations.literal: The Xihe supreme control office said:
translations.idiomatic: The Xihe supreme control office added:

sentences.zh: 「乞依熙河舊例，許涇原、秦鳳路、環慶及熙河路弓箭手投換，仍帶舊戶田土，耕種二年，即收入官，別招弓箭手。」

translations.literal: 'Please follow the old Xihe precedent, permitting archers of Jingyuan, Qinfeng, Huan-Qing, and Xihe circuits to transfer posts, still bringing their original household land, farming for two years, then the land reverts to government ownership and other archers are recruited.'
translations.idiomatic: 'It asked that Jingyuan, Qinfeng, Huan-Qing, and Xihe archers be allowed to transfer under the old Xihe rule, keeping their original land for two years of farming before the state reclaimed it and enrolled new archers.'

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Both proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，鄜延路經略司乞以新收復米脂、吳堡、義合、細浮圖、塞門五砦地置漢蕃弓箭手，及春耕種，其約束補職，並用舊條。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, the Fuyan commissioner requested using newly recovered lands of Mizhi, Wubao, Yihe, Xifutu, and Saimen—five stockades—to establish Han and tribal archers, with spring planting; constraints on appointment followed old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year Fuyan asked to settle Han and tribal archers on newly recovered land at the five stockades of Mizhi, Wubao, Yihe, Xifutu, and Saimen for spring planting, under the old appointment rules.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔提舉熙河等路弓箭手、營田、蕃部共爲一司，隸涇原路制置司。

translations.literal: In the second month, an edict ordered supervision of Xihe-circuit archers, military farms, and tribal affairs combined in one office, subordinate to the Jingyuan control commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month archer, military-farm, and tribal affairs for Xihe and related circuits were combined under one office subordinate to Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔：「蕃弓箭手陣亡，依漢弓箭手給賻。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, an edict ordered: 'Tribal archers killed in battle receive funeral gifts according to Han archers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict said: "Tribal archers killed in battle shall receive the same funeral gifts as Han archers.

sentences.zh: 弓箭手出戰，因傷及病羸不能自還者，並依軍例賜其家。」

translations.literal: Archers who went to battle and because of wounds or illness and weakness could not return on their own—all received grants to their families according to army precedent.'
translations.idiomatic: Archers who go into battle and cannot return by themselves because of wounds, illness, or weakness shall all have grants bestowed on their families according to army precedent."

sentences.zh: 七月，提舉熙河路弓箭手營田蕃部司康識、兼提舉舉營田張大寧言：「乞應新收復地差官分畫經界，選知農事廂軍耕佃，頃一人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Supervisor Kang Shi of the Xihe Archers, Military Farms, and Tribal Affairs Office and co-supervisor Zhang Daning said: 'For newly recovered lands we request officials dispatched to demarcate boundaries, select garrison troops knowledgeable in farming to till, one qing per man.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month supervisors Kang Shi and Zhang Daning said: "We ask that for newly recovered land, officials be assigned to demarcate boundaries and knowledgeable garrison troops selected to farm it, one man per qing.

sentences.zh: 其部押人員、節級及雇助人工歲入賞罰，並用熙河官莊法。

translations.literal: For their platoon officers, rank officers, and hired helpers, annual income rewards and punishments all followed Xihe official-estate law.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards and punishments for platoon officers, rank officers, and hired labor followed Xihe official-estate rules.

sentences.zh: 余並招弓箭手營田，每五十頃爲一營，差諳農事官一員幹當。」

translations.literal: The remainder would recruit archer military farms, each fifty qing forming one farm, with one official knowledgeable in farming assigned to manage.'
translations.idiomatic: The rest shall be farmed by recruiting archers for military farms, one camp for every fifty qing, with one official versed in agriculture assigned to manage it."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 六年，鄜延路經略司言：「弓箭手於近裏縣置田兩處，立戶及四丁已上，乞取一丁爲保甲，一丁爲弓箭手，有二丁至三丁，即且令充弓箭手。」

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Fuyan commissioner said: 'Archers have land in two nearby counties; for established households with four males or more, we request one be baojia and one an archer; with two or three males, let them serve as archer for the time being.'
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Fuyan reported: "Archers have land in two nearby counties. Households established with four adult males or more should provide one baojia member and one archer; those with two or three adult males should for now be ordered to serve as archers."

sentences.zh: 詔保甲願充弓箭手者聽，其見充弓箭手與當丁役，毋得退就保甲，陝西、河東亦如之。

translations.literal: An edict permitted baojia who wished to become archers; those already serving as archers with their male quota could not step back to baojia—Shaanxi and Hedong were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Baojia members who wished to become archers were allowed, but active archers fulfilling the male quota could not revert to baojia; Shaanxi and Hedong followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 八年，詔罷秦鳳路置場集教弓箭手，令經略司講求土人習教所宜立法。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, an edict abolished Qinfeng circuit's training-ground assembly instruction of archers, ordering the commissioner to study what local customs of instruction required and legislate accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the court abolished Qinfeng's centralized archer training grounds and ordered the commissioner to draft rules suited to local practice.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年，詔罷提舉熙河等路弓箭營田蕃部司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou, an edict abolished the Supervisory Office for Xihe-circuit Archers, Military Farms, and Tribal Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou 1 the Supervisory Office for Xihe Archers, Military Farms, and Tribal Affairs was abolished.

sentences.zh: 三年，兵部言：「涇原路隴山一帶系官地，例爲人侵冒，略無色役。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Ministry of War said: 'Along Long Mountain in Jingyuan is government land routinely encroached upon by people, with virtually no tax or corvée rendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Ministry of War said: "Government land along Long Mountain in Jingyuan is routinely encroached on and bears almost no tax or corvee.

sentences.zh: 非自朝廷置局招置摽撥，無以杜絕奸弊。」

translations.literal: Unless the court itself establishes an office to recruit and allocate it, there is no way to stop abuses.'
translations.idiomatic: Unless the court itself establishes an office to recruit settlers and allocate the land, there is no way to end the abuses."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 其後，殿前司副都指揮使劉昌祚奏根括隴山地凡一萬九百九十頃，招置弓箭手人馬凡五千二百六十一，賜敕書獎諭。

translations.literal: Later, Palace Front Office deputy commander Liu Changzuo memorialized that Long Mountain land totaling 10,990 qing was surveyed and archer men and horses totaling 5,261 were recruited and established; an edict-letter of commendation was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Later deputy Palace Front commander Liu Changzuo reported surveying 10,990 qing along Long Mountain and enrolling 5,261 archers and horses; the emperor rewarded him with a commendatory edict.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔將隴山一帶弓箭手人馬別置一將管幹，仍以涇原路第十二將爲名。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict ordered the archer men and horses along Long Mountain placed in a separate command for management, still named the Twelfth Command of Jingyuan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Long Mountain archers and horses were placed under a separate command, still called the Twelfth Command of Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔戶部遣官往熙河蘭岷路代孫路措置弓箭手土田。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to dispatch officials to the Xihe-Lan-Min circuit to replace Sun Lu in arranging archer land.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Revenue officials were sent to the Xihe-Lan-Min circuit to replace Sun Lu in managing archer land grants.

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年，樞密院言：「熙河蘭岷路經略司奏，本路弓箭手，自展置以來，累經戰鬥，內有戰功補三班差使已上之人，欲並遣歸所屬差使，仍以其地令親屬承刺，如無，即別召人承之。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaosheng, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: 'The Xihe-Lan-Min commissioner memorializes that this circuit's archers, since expansion and establishment, have repeatedly fought; among them are men promoted for merit to third-rank envoys and above—the court wishes to send them all back to their original posts, and let kin inherit their land by branding; if none, then recruit others to inherit.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaosheng 1 the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "The Xihe-Lan-Min pacification commission says that since this circuit's archers were expanded, they have repeatedly gone through battle, and among them are men promoted for battle merit to Third Rank dispatched service and above. It wishes to send them all back to their assigned posts, have relatives inherit their land by registration, and if there are no relatives, recruit others to inherit it."

sentences.zh: 三年正月，詔：「自今漢蕃人互投弓箭手者，官司不得收刺，違者杖一百。」

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, an edict stated: "From now on, when Han and tribal people mutually enroll one another as archers, the authorities shall not register and tattoo them; violators shall receive one hundred blows with the staff."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, an edict said: "From now on, when Han and tribal people enroll each other as archers, government offices may not register them; violators shall receive one hundred strokes."

sentences.zh: 五月，詔在京府界、諸路馬軍槍手並改充弓箭手，兼習蕃槍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, an edict ordered that lancers of the mounted armies in the capital prefecture circuit and in all circuits be reassigned as archers, and that they also train in tribal spearmanship.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, an edict transferred every mounted lancer in the capital region and across the circuits into the archer corps, requiring them to master tribal spear-fighting as well.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔張詢、巴宜專根括安西、金城膏腴地頃畝，可以招置弓箭手若干人，具團結以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict ordered Zhang Xun and Ba Yi to conduct a dedicated survey of the fertile fields of Anxi and Jincheng by acreage, to determine how many archers could be recruited there, and to report the full organization.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the court charged Zhang Xun and Ba Yi with a thorough land survey of the rich soil in Anxi and Jincheng, calculating how many archers the districts could support and submitting a complete plan for their recruitment and grouping.

sentences.zh: 元符元年二月，樞密院言：「鐘傳奏，近往涇原與章楶講究進築天都山、南牟等處。

translations.literal: In the second month of Yuanfu year 1, the Bureau of Military Affairs said, “Zhong Chuan memorialized that he recently went to Jingyuan and discussed with Zhang Jie the advancing construction of positions at Tiandu Mountain, Nanmou, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yuanfu year 1, the Bureau of Military Affairs said, “Zhong Chuan memorialized that he recently went to Jingyuan and discussed with Zhang Jie the advancing construction of positions at Tiandu Mountain, Nanmou, and other places.

sentences.zh: 今相度如展置青南訥心，須置一將。

translations.literal: Now, on inspection, if Qingnan and Nexin are to be expanded and established, one command must be set up.
translations.idiomatic: Now, on inspection, if Qingnan and Nexin are to be expanded and established, one command must be set up.

sentences.zh: 乞權于熙、秦兩路輟那。

translations.literal: We request temporary transfers from the Xi and Qin circuits.
translations.idiomatic: We request temporary transfers from the Xi and Qin circuits.

sentences.zh: 新城內土田並招弓箭手，仍置提舉官二員。

translations.literal: For the fields inside the new cities, bowmen should also be recruited, and two supervising officials should be established.
translations.idiomatic: For the fields inside the new cities, bowmen should also be recruited, and two supervising officials should be established.

sentences.zh: 熙、秦兩路弓箭手，每指揮以三百人為額，乞作二十指揮招置，不一二年間，須得數千民兵，以充武備。」

translations.literal: For the bowmen of the Xi and Qin circuits, each command should have a quota of three hundred men. We request recruitment and establishment of twenty commands; within one or two years, several thousand militia soldiers will surely be obtained to fill out military preparedness.”
translations.idiomatic: For the bowmen of the Xi and Qin circuits, each command should have a quota of three hundred men. We request recruitment and establishment of twenty commands; within one or two years, several thousand militia soldiers will surely be obtained to fill out military preparedness.”

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 七月，詔：「陝西、河東路新城砦合招弓箭手投換。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, an edict declared, “The new cities and stockades in Shaanxi and Hedong circuits should recruit bowmen for transfer enrollment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, an edict declared, “The new cities and stockades in Shaanxi and Hedong circuits should recruit bowmen for transfer enrollment.

sentences.zh: 其元祐八年四月不得招他路弓箭手指揮勿用。」

translations.literal: The directive of the fourth month of Yuanyou year 8, forbidding recruitment of bowmen from other circuits, is not to be used.”
