translations.idiomatic: The directive of the fourth month of Yuanyou year 8, forbidding recruitment of bowmen from other circuits, is not to be used.”

sentences.zh: 三年，提舉涇原路弓箭手安師文知涇州，罷提舉弓箭手司。

translations.literal: In year 3, An Shiwen, supervisor of bowmen in Jingyuan Circuit, became prefect of Jingzhou, and the Office for Supervising Bowmen was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, An Shiwen, supervisor of bowmen in Jingyuan Circuit, became prefect of Jingzhou, and the Office for Supervising Bowmen was abolished.

sentences.zh: 崇寧元年九月，樞密院勘會：「陝西五路並河東，自紹聖開斥以來，疆土至廣，遠者數百里，近者不減百里，罷兵以來，未曾措置。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of Chongning year 1, the Bureau of Military Affairs investigated and reported, “In the five Shaanxi circuits and Hedong, since the expansion begun in Shaosheng, the territory has become very broad, extending several hundred li at the farthest and no less than a hundred li at the nearest; since the troops were withdrawn, no arrangements have yet been made.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Chongning year 1, the Bureau of Military Affairs investigated and reported, “In the five Shaanxi circuits and Hedong, since the expansion begun in Shaosheng, the territory has become very broad, extending several hundred li at the farthest and no less than a hundred li at the nearest; since the troops were withdrawn, no arrangements have yet been made.

sentences.zh: 田多膏腴，雖累降詔置弓箭手，類多貧乏，或致逃走。

translations.literal: Much of the land is fertile. Although repeated edicts have ordered the establishment of bowmen, most have been poor and destitute, and some have ended up fleeing.
translations.idiomatic: Much of the land is fertile. Although repeated edicts have ordered the establishment of bowmen, most have been poor and destitute, and some have ended up fleeing.

sentences.zh: 州縣鎮砦污吏豪民冒占沃壤，利不及于平民，且並緣舊疆，侵佔新土。

translations.literal: Corrupt officials and powerful people in prefectures, counties, towns, and stockades have falsely occupied the fertile soil, so the benefits do not reach ordinary people; moreover, along the old borders they have encroached on and occupied the new lands.
translations.idiomatic: Corrupt officials and powerful people in prefectures, counties, towns, and stockades have falsely occupied the fertile soil, so the benefits do not reach ordinary people; moreover, along the old borders they have encroached on and occupied the new lands.

sentences.zh: 今遣官分往逐路提舉措置，應緣新疆土田，分定腴瘠，招置弓箭手，推行新降條法。

translations.literal: Now officials are being dispatched separately to each circuit to supervise arrangements. For all fields along the new frontier, they are to classify fertility and barrenness, recruit and establish bowmen, and implement the newly issued regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Now officials are being dispatched separately to each circuit to supervise arrangements. For all fields along the new frontier, they are to classify fertility and barrenness, recruit and establish bowmen, and implement the newly issued regulations.

sentences.zh: 舊弓箭手如願出佃新疆，亦仰相度施行。」

translations.literal: If old bowmen wish to go out and tenant the new frontier lands, this too is to be inspected and carried out.”
translations.idiomatic: If old bowmen wish to go out and tenant the new frontier lands, this too is to be inspected and carried out.”

sentences.zh: 詔湯景仁河東路，董采秦鳳路，陶節夫環慶路，安師文鄜延路，並提舉弓箭手。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Tang Jingren in Hedong Circuit, Dong Cai in Qinfeng Circuit, Tao Jiefu in Huanqing Circuit, and An Shiwen in Fuyan Circuit, all to supervise bowmen.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Tang Jingren in Hedong Circuit, Dong Cai in Qinfeng Circuit, Tao Jiefu in Huanqing Circuit, and An Shiwen in Fuyan Circuit, all to supervise bowmen.

sentences.zh: 元符三年罷提舉司，今復置。

translations.literal: The supervisory offices had been abolished in Yuanfu year 3; now they were restored.
translations.idiomatic: The supervisory offices had been abolished in Yuanfu year 3; now they were restored.

sentences.zh: 崇寧二年十一月，安師文奏：「據權通判德順軍事盧逢原申，根括打量出四將地分管下五砦、新占舊邊壕外地共四萬八千七百三十一頃有奇，乞特賜優賞。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Chongning, An Shiwen memorialized: "According to a report from Lu Fengyuan, acting vice-prefect in charge of affairs at De Shun Army, a survey has measured, under the four generals' jurisdictions, five forts and newly occupied land beyond the old border trenches, totaling 48,731-odd qing of land. I beg that exceptional rewards be granted."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Chongning 2, An Shiwen memorialized: "According to Lu Fengyuan, acting vice-prefect of Deshun Army, a survey measured 48,731-odd qing of land under the Four Commands, covering five stockades and newly seized ground beyond the old frontier trench. I request special commendation."

sentences.zh: 詔安師文特授左朝議大夫，差遣如故；

translations.literal: An edict specially appointed An Shiwen Left Grandee for Discussion of Governance, with his assignment unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The throne responded by promoting An Shiwen to Left Grandee for Discussion of Governance while leaving him in his present post.

sentences.zh: 盧逢原特授朝請郎。

translations.literal: Lu Fengyuan was specially appointed Gentleman for Attending at Court.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Fengyuan received a special appointment as Gentleman for Attending at Court.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，熙河路都轉運使鄭僅奉詔相度措置熙河新疆邊防利害，僅奏：「朝廷給田養漢蕃弓箭手，本以藩扞邊面，使顧慮家產，人自爲力。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year, Zheng Jin, chief transport commissioner of the Xihe Circuit, received an edict to assess and arrange the advantages and disadvantages of the new frontier defenses in Xihe. Jin memorialized: "The court's grant of land to support Han and tribal archers was originally meant to fence and shield the border, so that men would guard their households and exert themselves of their own accord.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year, Zheng Jin, chief transport commissioner of Xihe, was ordered to evaluate the new frontier defenses there. Zheng memorialized: "The court gave land to support Han and tribal archers originally to shield the frontier, making them mindful of their households and property so each would exert himself.

sentences.zh: 今拓境益遠，熙、秦漢蕃弓箭手乃在腹裏，理合移出。

translations.literal: Now that the frontier has been pushed ever farther, the Han and tribal archers of Xi and Qin find themselves deep in the interior; by right they ought to be moved outward.
translations.idiomatic: With the empire's reach stretching ever westward, the Han and tribal archers of Xi and Qin had been left behind in what was now the heartland; logically they should be redeployed to the new front.

sentences.zh: 然人情重遷，乞且家選一丁，官給口糧，團成耕夫使佃官莊。

translations.literal: Yet people are deeply reluctant to relocate. I beg that, for the present, each household choose one man; the government supply his rations; and these men be grouped as farmers to tenant official estates.
translations.idiomatic: But people are reluctant to move. I request for now that each household select one adult male, that the state provide his rations, and that they be organized as tenant farmers on government estates.

sentences.zh: 遇成熟日，除糧種外，半入官，半給耕夫，候稍成次第，聽其所便。」

translations.literal: When harvest came, seed grain would be set aside; half the remainder would go to the state and half to the farmers. Once things had gradually taken shape in due order, they might be allowed to do as they found convenient."
translations.idiomatic: At harvest, after seed grain is deducted, half shall go to the state and half to the farmers; once the system has gradually taken shape, let them do what is convenient."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court accepted the plan.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，趙挺之言：「湟、鄯之復，歲費朝廷供億一千五百余萬。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, Zhao Tingzhi said: "The recovery of Huang and Shan costs the court more than fifteen million in annual provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year, Zhao Tingzhi said: "Since Huang and Shan were recovered, court supplies have cost more than fifteen million strings a year.

sentences.zh: 鄭僅初建官莊之議，朝廷令會計其歲入，凡五莊之入，乃能支一莊之費。

translations.literal: When Zheng Jin first proposed the establishment of official estates, the court ordered an accounting of their yearly income. The income of five estates could barely cover the expenses of one.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng Jin had first proposed government farming estates, the court had audited their annual returns—and found that revenue from five estates barely covered the running costs of one.

sentences.zh: 蓋鄯、湟乃西蕃之二小國，湟州謂之邈川，鄯州謂之青唐，與河南本爲三國，其地濱河，多沃壤。

translations.literal: For Shan and Huang had been two small states of the Western Tribes: Huang was called Miaochuan, Shan was called Qingtang; together with Henan they had formed three states. Their lands lay along the river and held much rich soil.
translations.idiomatic: Shan and Huang, after all, had once been two petty kingdoms of the Western Tribes—Huang known as Miaochuan, Shan as Qingtang—part of a trio with Henan, all their lands strung along the river in broad belts of fertile ground.

sentences.zh: 昔三國分據時，民之供輸于其國厚，而又每族各有酋長以統領之，皆衣食贍足，取於所屬之民。

translations.literal: In the days when the three states held separate sway, the people's contributions to their rulers were heavy; moreover each clan had its own chief to command it, and all lived in ample food and clothing, drawing what they needed from the people under them.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old tripartite order, subjects had paid heavily to their own rulers; every clan had its chief, and those chiefs lived well—clothed, fed, and sustained entirely by the labor of the people beneath them.

sentences.zh: 自朝廷收復以來，名爲使蕃民各占舊地以居，其實屢更戰鬥，殺戮竄逐，所存無幾。

translations.literal: Since the court recovered the region, it was said that tribal people would each occupy their old lands and dwell there; in truth repeated fighting, slaughter, and flight had left almost no one.
translations.idiomatic: After imperial recovery, the policy was nominally one of letting tribal people return to their ancestral lands; in practice ceaseless war, massacre, and displacement had reduced the population to almost nothing.

sentences.zh: 今兵將官、帥臣、知州多召閑民以居，貪冒者或受金乃與之地，又私取其羊馬駝畜，然無一毫租賦供官。

translations.literal: Now generals, commanders, and prefects often summoned idle settlers to occupy the land. The greedy among them sometimes took bribes before granting plots, and privately seized sheep, horses, and camels—yet not one fraction of rent or tax reached the government.
translations.idiomatic: Nowadays commanders, circuit officials, and prefects were filling the land with opportunistic settlers; the corrupt sold plots for gold, skimmed off sheep, horses, and camels for themselves, and still sent not a copper of rent or tax to the state.

sentences.zh: 若以昔輸於三國者百分之一入于縣官，即湟州資費有餘矣。」

translations.literal: If even one hundredth of what the people once paid to the three states were paid into the government, Huangzhou's expenses would be more than covered."
translations.idiomatic: If even one percent of what they formerly paid to the three states were paid to the county officials, Huangzhou would have more than enough for its expenses."

sentences.zh: 帝深然之。

translations.literal: The emperor strongly agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor found the argument deeply persuasive.

sentences.zh: 翌日，知樞密院張康國入見，力言不可使新民出租，恐致擾動衆情；

translations.literal: The next day, Zhang Kangguo, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, entered audience and forcefully argued that the new settlers must not be made to pay rent, lest popular sentiment be disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Zhang Kangguo, head of the Bureau of Military Affairs, pressed the opposite case before the throne: taxing the new settlers would only stir unrest among them.

sentences.zh: 且言蕃民既刺手背爲兵，安可更出租賦。

translations.literal: He further said that since the tribal people had already been tattooed on the hand as soldiers, how could they also be charged rent and tax?
translations.idiomatic: Besides, he asked, the tribal people had already been branded on the hand as soldiers—how could they be taxed like ordinary farmers?

sentences.zh: 帝因宣諭：「新民不可搖動，兼已令多招弓箭手矣。」

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon declared: "The new settlers must not be unsettled; moreover, orders have already been issued to recruit more archers."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then publicly instructed: "The new settlers must not be disturbed, and we have already ordered more archers recruited."

sentences.zh: 廷之奏：「弓箭手，官給以地而不出租，此中國法也。

translations.literal: Tingzhi memorialized: "For archers, the government grants land and does not collect rent—this is the law of the Middle Kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhi memorialized: "For archers, the state gives land and does not collect rent; this is the law for China.

sentences.zh: 若蕃兵，則其舊俗既輸納供億之物，出戰又人皆爲兵，非弓箭手之比。

translations.literal: Tribal soldiers, by contrast, followed their old custom of paying provisions to the state; in war every man was a soldier. They were not to be compared with archers.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal warriors were another matter: by ancient custom they had always rendered supplies to their rulers, and in wartime every man fought. They could not be equated with militia archers.

sentences.zh: 今朝廷所費不貲，經營數年，得此西蕃之地，若無一毫之入，而官吏、戍卒饋餉之費皆出於朝廷，何計之拙也！」

translations.literal: Now the court's expenditures are beyond counting. After years of effort it has gained this land of the Western Tribes; if there is not one fraction of revenue, while the costs of officials, garrison troops, and provisions all come from the court—what a clumsy plan!"
translations.idiomatic: Now the court spends beyond measure and, after years of effort, has won this western tribal territory; if it receives not the slightest revenue while the costs of officials, garrisons, and supply all come from the court, what a clumsy plan this is!"

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「已令姚雄經畫。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Yao Xiong has already been ordered to plan the matter."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Yao Xiong has already been ordered to plan it."

sentences.zh: 時累詔令雄括空閒地，召人耕墾出課，故深以挺之所奏爲然。

translations.literal: At that time repeated edicts had ordered Yao to survey idle land and summon people to open it for cultivation and taxation; therefore the emperor deeply agreed with what Tingzhi had memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated edicts had already sent Yao Xiong to identify vacant land and bring settlers in to farm it and pay tax—so on this point, at least, the emperor sided firmly with Tingzhi.

sentences.zh: 挺之又云：「鄯、湟之復，羌人屢叛，溪撦羅撒走降夏國，夏國納之，時時寇邊，兵不解嚴而饋運極艱。

translations.literal: Tingzhi also said: "Since the recovery of Shan and Huang, the Qiang have repeatedly rebelled. Xipo Luosa fled and surrendered to the Xia state; the Xia accepted him and raided the border from time to time. The army could not stand down, and supply transport became extremely difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhi further said: "Since Shan and Huang were recovered, the Qiang have repeatedly rebelled; Xipo Luosa fled and surrendered to Western Xia, which accepted him and repeatedly raided the border. The troops never relax their alert, and supply transport is extremely difficult.

sentences.zh: 和糴入粟，鄯州以每石價至七十貫，湟州五十餘貫。

translations.literal: Under government purchase of grain, the price at Shan reached seventy strings per shi, and at Huang more than fifty strings.
translations.idiomatic: Under the court's grain-purchase program, a single shi cost seventy strings at Shan and more than fifty at Huang.

sentences.zh: 蓋倉場利於客人入中乞取，而官吏利於請給斛鬥，中官獲利百倍，人人皆富。

translations.literal: This was because the granary system profited merchant contractors who entered supplies to draw payment, while officials profited from requesting disbursements of grain; middlemen reaped profits a hundredfold, and everyone grew rich.
translations.idiomatic: The reason was simple corruption: warehouse contractors profited when outside merchants delivered grain on credit; local officials profited when they requisitioned disbursements. Middlemen multiplied their gains a hundred times over, and everyone along the chain grew fat.

sentences.zh: 是以上下相蒙，而爲朝廷之害。」

translations.literal: Thus superiors and subordinates deceived one another, to the court's harm."
translations.idiomatic: For this reason superiors and subordinates deceive one another, harming the court."

sentences.zh: 熙寧三年，熙河運司以歲計不足，乞以官茶博糴，每茶三斤易粟一斛，其利甚博。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xining, the Xihe transport office, finding its annual accounts insufficient, requested permission to use official tea in barter purchase of grain, exchanging one shi of grain for three jin of tea—a profit greatly to its advantage.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 3, the Xihe transport commission, short on its annual budget, asked to barter official tea for grain at three jin of tea per shi—a trade wildly in its favor.

sentences.zh: 朝廷謂茶馬司本以博馬，不可以博糴，于茶馬司歲額外，增買川茶兩倍茶，朝廷別出錢二百萬給之，令提刑司封樁。

translations.literal: The court held that the Tea-and-Horse Office existed to trade tea for horses and could not be used for grain purchase; beyond the Tea-and-Horse Office's annual quota, Sichuan tea was to be bought at double volume, with the court separately allocating two million strings, to be sealed and stored under the supervision of the judicial-intendant office.
translations.idiomatic: The court ruled that the Tea-and-Horse Bureau existed to trade for horses, not grain. It therefore authorized a separate purchase of twice the usual allotment of Sichuan tea, funded by two million strings from the central treasury and held under seal by the judicial-intendant office.

sentences.zh: 又令茶馬官程之邵兼領轉運使，由是數歲邊用粗足。

translations.literal: The Tea-and-Horse official Cheng Zhi Shao was also ordered to serve concurrently as transport commissioner; thereafter, for several years, frontier expenses were roughly sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhi Shao of the Tea-and-Horse Bureau was also made transport commissioner; for several years after that, frontier needs were more or less met.

sentences.zh: 及挺之再相，熙河漕司屢申以軍糧不足爲急，乃令會去年拋降錢數共一千一百萬馱，一馱價直三千至四十千，二百馱所轉不可勝計，今年已降撥銀、錢、絹等共九百萬，乃令更支兩倍茶一百萬馱。

translations.literal: When Tingzhi again became chief councilor, the Xihe grain office repeatedly reported military grain supplies as urgently insufficient. An accounting was ordered of last year's appropriated funds, totaling eleven million loads; each load was worth from three thousand to forty thousand strings, and two hundred loads' worth of transfers were beyond counting. This year silver, cash, and silk totaling nine million had already been allocated; orders were then issued to disburse an additional one million loads' worth of double-volume tea.
translations.idiomatic: When Tingzhi returned as chief councilor, Xihe's grain commissioners kept warning that military rations were critically short. Last year's appropriations alone had totaled eleven million pack-loads—each load valued anywhere from three to forty thousand strings—with transfers in the hundreds of loads beyond easy reckoning. Nine million in silver, cash, and silk had already been sent down this year; the court now ordered another million pack-loads' worth of the supplemental double tea released.

sentences.zh: 張康國同進呈，得旨，乃密檢元豐以來茶惟用博馬指揮以進。

translations.literal: Zhang Kangguo jointly presented the matter, received the imperial decision, and secretly searched out the Yuanfeng-era directives stating that tea was to be used only for trading horses, and submitted them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Kangguo joined in the presentation, secured the emperor's assent, and then quietly dug up the Yuanfeng orders restricting tea to horse purchases and laid them before the throne.

sentences.zh: 然康國不知兩倍茶自非博馬之數，而何執中、鄧洵武雜然和之。

translations.literal: Yet Kangguo did not understand that the double-volume tea had never been part of the horse-trade quota; He Zhizhong and Deng Xunwu all chimed in with agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Kangguo, however, failed to grasp that the supplemental double tea had never belonged to the horse-trade quota—and He Zhizhong and Deng Xunwu piled on in agreement.

sentences.zh: 由是兩倍茶更不支給，而鄯、湟兵費不給矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon disbursement of the double-volume tea ceased, and military expenses at Shan and Huang could no longer be met.
translations.idiomatic: The double tea was cut off—and with it went the means to pay for the armies at Shan and Huang.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔：「邊地廣而耕墾未至，膏腴荒閑，芻粟翔踴，歲糴本不貲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, an edict stated: "The frontier is broad, yet cultivation has not reached it; rich land lies idle and waste, and fodder and grain soar in price. Annual purchase costs are beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, an edict said: "The borderlands are vast but cultivation has not reached them; fertile land lies idle, fodder and grain prices soar, and the annual cost of purchased grain is incalculable.

sentences.zh: 昨累降指揮，令涇原路經略司與提舉弓箭手司措置，召人開墾，以助塞下積粟，爲備邊無窮之利。

translations.literal: Repeated directives had recently been issued ordering the Jingyuan Circuit military commissioner and the office for supervising archers to arrange matters, summon people to open land, assist in accumulating grain below the passes, and create inexhaustible benefit for frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated orders had already gone out directing the Jingyuan military commissioner and the archer-supervision office to bring settlers in, break new ground, and build up grain reserves beyond the frontier passes—an inexhaustible source of strength for border defense.

sentences.zh: 訪聞提舉弓箭手司與經略司執見不同，措置議論，不務和協。

translations.literal: It was reported that the office for supervising archers and the military commissioner held conflicting views and, in planning and discussion, did not seek harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Word reached the court, however, that the archer office and the military commissioner were at cross purposes, quarreling over policy instead of coordinating it.

sentences.zh: 其提舉涇原路弓箭手錢歸善可罷。」

translations.literal: Qian Guishan, supervisor of archers in the Jingyuan Circuit, should be dismissed."
translations.idiomatic: Qian Guishan, the Jingyuan archer commissioner, was to be removed from office."

sentences.zh: 大觀三年二月，臣僚言：「自復西寧州，饋給每多，而儲積未廣，買價數增，市物隨踴，地利不辟，兵籍不敷，蓋招置之術失講，勸利之法未興也。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Daguan, officials said: "Since the recovery of Xining Prefecture, supplies sent forward have constantly increased, yet stored reserves have not grown; purchase prices have repeatedly risen, and market goods have risen with them. The land's advantages have not been opened, and military rolls are not filled—because the methods for recruiting settlers have been neglected and the policies for encouraging profit have not been enacted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Daguan 3, court officials said: "Since Xining Prefecture was recovered, supply demands have kept increasing, reserves have not grown broad, purchase prices have repeatedly risen, market goods have risen with them, land resources have not been opened, and military rolls are insufficient. This is because recruitment methods have not been studied and profit-encouraging laws have not been developed.

sentences.zh: 乞委帥臣、監司講求，或募或招，何爲而可足弓箭手之數，以期於不闕；

translations.literal: They requested that commanders and supervisory officials be commissioned to investigate whether recruitment or summons could fill the number of archers so that none would be lacking.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that circuit commanders and supervisory commissioners study the problem: by recruitment or summons, what would it take to fill the archer rolls without shortfall?

sentences.zh: 或拘或誘，何爲而使蕃部著業而責以耕耘。

translations.literal: By constraint or inducement, what would make the tribal departments settle on their occupations and be charged with cultivation?
translations.idiomatic: By coercion or incentive, what would bind tribal communities to the land and hold them to the plow?

sentences.zh: 田既墾則穀自盈，募既充而兵益振，是收班超之功，盡充國之利也。」

translations.literal: Once fields are opened, grain will naturally abound; once recruits are filled, the army will grow stronger—this would achieve the achievement of Ban Chao and realize fully the benefit of Zhao Chongguo."
translations.idiomatic: Once fields are opened, grain will fill the storehouses; once recruitment is complete, the army will be strengthened. This will recover Ban Chao's achievement and fully realize Zhao Chongguo's benefit."

sentences.zh: 詔：「熙、河、洮、岷前後收復，歲月深久，得其地而未得其利，得其民而未得其用。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Xi, He, Tao, and Min were recovered one after another over many years. The court gained their lands but not their profit; it gained their people but not their use.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Xi, He, Tao, and Min have been recovered over many years; we have gained the land without gaining its profits and gained the people without gaining their use.

sentences.zh: 地利不辟，兵籍不敷，歲仰朝廷供億，非持久之道。

translations.literal: The land's advantages are not opened; military rolls are not filled; each year the court is relied upon for provisions—this is no lasting way.
translations.idiomatic: Land lay idle, rolls empty, and every year the treasury bore the whole burden of supply—no policy built to endure.

sentences.zh: 可令詳究本末，條畫來上。」

translations.literal: Let the matter be thoroughly investigated from beginning to end, and outlined plans submitted."
translations.idiomatic: Officials were ordered to trace the problem to its roots and submit detailed plans."

sentences.zh: 政和三年，秦鳳路經略安撫使何常奏：

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, He Chang, military commissioner and pacification commissioner of the Qin-Feng Circuit, memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe 3, He Chang, military commissioner and pacification commissioner of the Qin-Feng Circuit, submitted a memorial:

sentences.zh: 自古行師用兵，或騎或步，率因地形。

translations.literal: From antiquity in marching armies and employing troops, sometimes cavalry and sometimes infantry, generally according to terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity, armies have fought on horseback or on foot, as terrain dictates.

sentences.zh: 兵法曰：「蕃兵惟勁馬奔沖，漢兵惟強弩掎角。」

translations.literal: The art of war says: "Tribal troops rely only on powerful horses charging in assault; Han troops rely only on strong crossbows for pincer fire."
translations.idiomatic: The manuals say: "Frontier cavalry excel at the thundering charge; Han forces excel at the crossbow pincer."

sentences.zh: 蓋蕃長於馬，漢長於弩也。

translations.literal: For the tribal peoples are skilled at horses, and the Han are skilled at crossbows."
translations.idiomatic: For the frontier peoples were masters of the horse, and the Han masters of the crossbow.

sentences.zh: 今則不然。

translations.literal: Now it is not so.
translations.idiomatic: That is no longer the case.

sentences.zh: 西賊有山間部落謂之「步跋子」者，上下山坡，出入溪潤，最能逾高超遠，輕足善走。

translations.literal: The Western bandits have a mountain tribe called the "Bubazi"; ascending and descending hillsides, entering and exiting streams and ravines, they are best at surpassing heights and spanning distances—light of foot and good at running.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Xia have a mountain tribe called the "Bubazi": they climb and descend slopes, enter and leave streams and ravines, excel at crossing heights and distances, and are light-footed and swift runners.

sentences.zh: 有平夏騎兵謂之「鐵鷂子」者，百里而走，千里而期，最能倏往忽來，若電擊雲飛。

translations.literal: There are Pingxia cavalry called the "Iron Hawks," who run a hundred li and keep a thousand-li appointment; they are best at sudden coming and going, like lightning striking and clouds flying.
translations.idiomatic: They have Pingxia cavalry called the "Iron Hawks": riding a hundred li and keeping appointments a thousand li away, they excel at sudden coming and going, like lightning striking and clouds flying.

sentences.zh: 每于平原馳騁之處遇敵，則多用鐵鷂子以爲沖冒奔突之兵；

translations.literal: Whenever they meet the enemy on plains where horses gallop freely, they mostly use Iron Hawks as troops for assault, charge, and sudden dashes;
translations.idiomatic: On open plains suited to a galloping charge, they rely chiefly on the Iron Hawks for assault and breakout.

sentences.zh: 山谷深險之處遇敵，則多用步跋子以爲擊刺掩襲之用。

translations.literal: when they meet the enemy in deep and perilous mountain valleys, they mostly use Bubazi for striking, stabbing, and surprise raids.
translations.idiomatic: In steep, narrow valleys they deploy the Bubazi for close strikes and ambush.

sentences.zh: 此西人步騎之長也。

translations.literal: These are the strengths of the Western people's infantry and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Such were the strengths of the enemy's foot and horse.

sentences.zh: 我諸路並塞之民，皆是弓箭手地分，平居以田獵騎射爲能，緩急以追逐馳騁相尚。

translations.literal: Our people in all circuits along the frontier are all enrolled in archer districts; in peacetime they take field hunting and mounted archery as their skill, and in urgency they esteem pursuit and galloping.
translations.idiomatic: Along our frontier circuits the inhabitants are enrolled as archers, who in peace hone their skill at hunting and mounted archery and in war pride themselves on the chase and the charge.

sentences.zh: 又沿邊土兵，習於山川，慣於馳驟。

translations.literal: Moreover, frontier native troops are practiced in mountains and rivers and accustomed to hard riding.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier native levies know the hills and streams and are hardened to hard riding.

sentences.zh: 關東戍卒，多是硬弩手及摽牌手，不惟扞賊勁矢，亦可使賊馬驚潰。

translations.literal: Garrison soldiers of Guandong are mostly heavy crossbowmen and shield-bearers; not only do they ward off the bandits' powerful arrows, they can also make enemy horses startled and routed.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison troops of Guandong are chiefly heavy crossbowmen and shield-bearers who not only turn aside the enemy's shafts but can panic and scatter his horses.

sentences.zh: 此中國步騎之利也。

translations.literal: These are the advantages of China's infantry and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Such were the strengths of our own foot and horse.

sentences.zh: 至道中，王超、丁罕等討繼遷，是時馬上用弩，遇賊則萬弩齊發，賊不能措手足而遁。

translations.literal: In the Zhidao era, Wang Chao, Ding Han, and others campaigned against Jiqian; at that time they used crossbows on horseback, and when they met bandits ten thousand crossbows fired together—the bandits could not set hand or foot before fleeing.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhidao era Wang Chao and Ding Han campaigned against Li Jiqian; mounted crossbowmen then loosed ten thousand bolts at once, leaving the enemy no room to move before they fled.

sentences.zh: 又元豐間，劉昌祚等趨靈州，賊衆守隘，官軍不能進。

translations.literal: Again, in the Yuanfeng era Liu Changzuo and others hastened to Ling Prefecture; the bandit host guarded the passes and the official army could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: During Yuanfeng Liu Changzuo marched on Ling Prefecture but found the enemy holding the passes and blocking the army's advance.

sentences.zh: 於是用牌子爲先鋒，賊下馬臨官軍，其勢甚盛，昌祚等乃以牌子踢跳閃爍，振以響環，賊馬驚潰。

translations.literal: Thereupon they used shield-bearers as vanguard; the bandits dismounted and confronted the official army with very strong momentum. Changzuo and the others then had the shield-bearers kick, leap, dodge, and flicker, shaking rattling rings, and the bandits' horses were startled and routed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu deployed shield-bearers as vanguard. The enemy dismounted and pressed the attack with overwhelming force, whereupon Changzuo's men leapt and feinted with their shields, rattling the noise-rings until the enemy horses bolted in panic.

sentences.zh: 若遇賊于山林險隘之處，先以牌子賊，次以勁弓強弩與神臂弓射賊先鋒，則矢不虛發，而皆穿心達臆矣。

translations.literal: If one meets bandits in wooded mountain defiles, first send shield-bearers against the enemy, then use powerful bows, strong crossbows, and Divine Arm crossbows to shoot the bandits' vanguard; then arrows do not fly in vain, and all pierce the heart and reach the breast.
translations.idiomatic: In wooded defiles, send shield-men first, then strike the enemy vanguard with powerful bows, heavy crossbows, and Divine Arm crossbows—every shaft finding its mark, piercing heart and breast.

sentences.zh: 或遇賊于平原廣野之間，則馬上用弩攢射，可以一發而盡殪。

translations.literal: Or if one meets bandits on broad plains and open fields, then mounted crossbow volley fire can annihilate them in a single discharge.
translations.idiomatic: On open plains, a volley of mounted crossbow fire could annihilate the enemy in a single discharge.

sentences.zh: 兼牌子與馬上用弩，皆已試之效，不可不講。

translations.literal: Moreover, both shield tactics and mounted crossbows are tried and proven effects; one cannot fail to study them.
translations.idiomatic: Both shield tactics and mounted crossbows had been proven in battle and deserved the fullest attention.

sentences.zh: 前所謂勁馬奔沖，強弩掎角，其利兩得之，而賊之步跋子與鐵鷂子皆不足破也。

translations.literal: The aforementioned powerful horse charge and strong crossbow pincer—their advantages are both obtained, and the bandits' Bubazi and Iron Hawks are all insufficient to break through.
translations.idiomatic: Thus one could gain both the charging horse and the crossbow pincer—and the enemy's Bubazi and Iron Hawks would no longer suffice to break one's line.

sentences.zh: 又步兵之中，必先擇其魁健材力之卒，皆用斬馬刀，別以一將統之，如唐李嗣業用陌刀法。

translations.literal: Again, among the infantry one must first select the sturdiest and strongest soldiers, all armed with horse-chopping sabers and placed under a separate general's command, as Tang's Li Siye used the modao method.
translations.idiomatic: Among the infantry, select the stoutest and strongest men, arm them with horse-chopping sabers, and place them under a dedicated commander—as Li Siye of Tang had wielded the modao corps.

sentences.zh: 遇鐵鷂子衝突，或掠我陣腳，或踐踏我步人，則用斬馬刀以進，是取勝之一奇也。

translations.literal: When Iron Hawks charge, whether they sweep our formation's flanks or trample our foot soldiers, then advance with horse-chopping sabers—this is one extraordinary means of victory.
translations.idiomatic: When Iron Hawks broke through—whether skirting the flank or riding down infantry—advancing with horse-chopping sabers was a decisive stratagem.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密院劄與諸路經略司。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to circulate an official notice to the pacification commissions of all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to circulate the memorial to each circuit pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔：「西羌久爲邊患，乍叛乍服，譎詐不常。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict: "The Western Qiang have long been a frontier scourge, suddenly rebelling and suddenly submitting, crafty and inconstant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the reign an edict declared: "The Western Qiang have long plagued the frontier, rebelling one day and submitting the next, treacherous and unpredictable.

sentences.zh: 頃在先朝，使者在廷，猶或犯境。

translations.literal: Recently under the previous court, even when envoys were at court they still sometimes violated the border.
translations.idiomatic: Even when their envoys were received at our court under the late emperor, they still raided the border.

sentences.zh: 今植養積歲，屢饑久困，雖誓表已進，羌夷之性不保其往。

translations.literal: Now, though fed and nurtured for accumulated years and repeatedly hungry and long beset, although oaths and memorials have been submitted, the nature of Qiang and Yi cannot guarantee their past conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Though nurtured for years and now weakened by repeated famine, and though they have submitted written oaths, the Qiang and Yi cannot be trusted to keep their word.

sentences.zh: 修備禦於無事之時，戒不虞於萃聚之際，正在今日。

translations.literal: To repair defenses in times of no incident and guard against the unexpected when they mass their forces—the time is precisely today.
translations.idiomatic: To prepare defenses in peacetime and guard against sudden attack when they mass their forces—that urgency is now.

sentences.zh: 可令陝西、河東路帥臣訓練兵伍，除治軍器，繕修樓櫓，收積芻糧，常若寇至。

translations.literal: Command the commanders of Shaanxi and Hedong circuits to drill troops, clear and maintain weapons, repair towers and palisades, gather and store fodder and grain, always as if bandits were arriving.
translations.idiomatic: The commanders of Shaanxi and Hedong were ordered to drill troops, maintain arms, repair towers and stockades, stock fodder and grain, and stand ready as though the enemy were at the gates.

sentences.zh: 不可謂已進誓表，輒或弛怠，墮其奸謀。

translations.literal: One must not say that because oaths have been submitted one may grow lax and fall into their crafty schemes.
translations.idiomatic: Officials must not grow complacent because oaths had been filed, or fall prey to enemy treachery.

sentences.zh: 所有弓箭手、蕃兵，常令優恤，逃亡者可速招補，貧乏者亦令貸借。

translations.literal: For all archers and tribal troops, constantly order favorable treatment; runaways may quickly be recruited to fill gaps, and the impoverished are also to be granted loans.
translations.idiomatic: Archers and tribal auxiliaries were to be well treated: deserters promptly re-enrolled, the destitute granted loans.

sentences.zh: 將佐偏裨，如或軟懦失職，具名以聞，或寇至失事，並行軍法。」

translations.literal: Officers and junior commanders—if any are soft and cowardly and neglect duty, report their names; or if when bandits arrive affairs are lost, all are subject to military law."
translations.idiomatic: Commanders found timid or negligent were to be reported by name; any who failed when the enemy came would face military punishment."

sentences.zh: 五年二月，詔：「陝西、河東逐路，自紹聖開拓邊疆以來，及西寧、湟、廓、洮州、積石等處新邊，各有包占良田，併合招置弓箭手，以爲邊防籬落。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, an edict: "In Shaanxi and Hedong, each circuit, since the Shaosheng opening of the frontier, and at new frontiers such as Xining, Huang, Kuo, and Tao Prefectures and Jishi, good farmland has been allotted and occupied and archers jointly recruited to serve as a frontier defense fence.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year an edict said: "Since the Shaosheng frontier expansion, in the Shaanxi and Hedong circuits and on the new frontiers at Xining, Huang, Kuo, Tao Prefecture, Jishi, and other places, fertile lands have been enclosed and should all recruit archers to serve as the frontier fence.

sentences.zh: 至今累年，曠土尚多，應募人數未廣。

translations.literal: To the present, after accumulated years, idle land is still plentiful and enrolled numbers are not broad.
translations.idiomatic: Yet after many years much land still lay unused and recruitment had fallen short.

sentences.zh: 蓋緣自罷專置提舉官隸屬經略司，事權不專，頗失措置。

translations.literal: This is because, since abolishing the specially established overseeing official and subordinating the office to the pacification commission, authority over affairs is not exclusive and deployment has been quite misplaced.
translations.idiomatic: This owed largely to the abolition of dedicated archer overseers and their subordination to the pacification commissions, which diluted authority and left affairs poorly managed.

sentences.zh: 根括打量、催督開墾、理斷交侵等職事，盡在極邊，帥臣無由親到。

translations.literal: Auditing surveys, supervising and urging the opening of land, and adjudicating mutual encroachments and other duties all lie at the extreme frontier, and circuit commanders have no means to visit personally.
translations.idiomatic: Surveying, supervising cultivation, and adjudicating land disputes all took place on the remotest frontier, where circuit commanders could not personally oversee the work.

sentences.zh: 即今夏人通貢，邊鄙安靜。

translations.literal: Just now the Xia people are sending tribute and the frontier margins are quiet.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia were currently sending tribute and the frontier was calm.

sentences.zh: 若不乘此委官往來督責，多方招刺弓箭手墾辟閒田，補助邊計，以寬飛輓之勞，竊慮因循浸久，曠土愈多，銷耗民兵人額，有害邊防大計。

translations.literal: If one does not seize this moment to commission officials to travel back and forth supervising and urging, recruiting archers in many ways to open idle fields and supplement frontier accounts so as to ease the labor of emergency transport, I privately fear procrastination spreading over time, idle land growing ever more, wearing down militia quotas, and harming the great frontier-defense plan.
translations.idiomatic: Unless officials were now dispatched to recruit archers, open idle land, ease the burden of emergency requisition, and supplement frontier finances, procrastination would leave ever more land fallow, deplete militia quotas, and undermine frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 兼提舉文臣玩習翰墨，多務安養，罕能沖冒寒暑。

translations.literal: Moreover, the overseeing civil officials are fond of practicing brush and ink, mostly devoted to comfortable nurture, and rarely able to brave cold and heat.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the civil overseers had been scholars devoted to comfort and ill suited to hardship in the field.

sentences.zh: 可令陝西、河東逐路，並復置提舉弓箭手司，仍各選差武臣一員充，理任、請給、恩數等並依提舉保甲條例施行。

translations.literal: Command Shaanxi and Hedong, each circuit, all to restore the Office for Overseeing Archers, still selecting one military official each to fill the post; tenure, stipends, honors, and the like are all to follow the regulations for overseeing baojia.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi and Hedong were each to restore an Office for Overseeing Archers, staffed by a military officer, with tenure, pay, and perquisites per the baojia regulations.

sentences.zh: 每路各置幹當公事使臣二員。

translations.literal: Each circuit is to establish two imperial commissioners to manage routine affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Each circuit would also appoint two commissioners to handle routine business.

sentences.zh: 仍每歲令樞密院取索逐路招到弓箭手並開墾過地土，比較優劣殿最，取旨黜陟。

translations.literal: Still, each year order the Bureau of Military Affairs to request from each circuit the archers recruited and land opened for cultivation, compare merit high and low and first and last, and obtain imperial decision for promotion and demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the Bureau of Military Affairs would review each circuit's archer recruitment and land reclaimed, rank officials by performance, and recommend promotions and demotions.

sentences.zh: 合措置事節，所差官條畫以聞。」

translations.literal: Matters fitting arrangement of measures—the dispatched officials should outline them in detail and report."
translations.idiomatic: The appointed officials were to submit a detailed plan for implementing these measures."

sentences.zh: 八月，樞密院言：「欲將近裏弓箭手地，但有爭訟侵冒之處，並行打量，庶幾杜絕侵冒之弊。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "We wish to take archer lands in the nearer interior; wherever there are disputes and encroachments, all are to be surveyed, hoping thereby to cut off the abuse of encroachment."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "We wish to survey all archer lands in the interior districts wherever disputes or encroachments have arisen, so that abuses of encroachment may perhaps be ended."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 是月，提舉河東路弓箭手司奏：「本司體訪得沿邊州軍逐處招置弓箭手，多將人戶舊用工開耕之地指射剗奪，其舊佃人遂至失業。

translations.literal: That month the Office for Overseeing Hedong Circuit Archers memorialized: "This office on inquiry learned that along the frontier prefectures and armies, at each place where archers were recruited, many targeted and seized lands that households had long tilled and opened for cultivation, and the original tenants thus came to lose their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Hedong Office for Overseeing Archers reported: "This office has investigated and found that in frontier prefectures and armies, archer recruitment in each place has often claimed and seized land long cultivated by households, causing the original tenants to lose their livelihood.

sentences.zh: 且所出租，僅比佃戶五分之一，於公私俱不便。

translations.literal: Moreover the rent paid was only one-fifth compared to tenants, inconvenient for both public and private interests.
translations.idiomatic: The rent collected was only a fifth of what tenants had paid—harmful to public revenue and private interest alike.

sentences.zh: 今欲將系官莊屯田已有人租佃及五年者，並不在招置弓箭手請射之限。

translations.literal: Now we wish that official estate garrison fields already leased and tilled by others for five years or more all fall outside the limits of archer recruitment and land claims.
translations.idiomatic: Fields on official estates already rented for five years or more were to be excluded from archer land claims.

sentences.zh: 其河東路察訪司初不以邊防民兵爲重，姑息佃戶，致有此弊。

translations.literal: The Hedong Circuit Inspection Commission from the first did not regard frontier defense militia as important, indulging tenants and leading to this abuse.
translations.idiomatic: The Hedong inspection commission had neglected frontier militia in favor of indulging tenants, causing the problem.

sentences.zh: 欲乞應熙寧八年以前人戶租佃官田，並先取問佃人，如願投刺弓箭手，每出一丁，許依條給見佃田二頃五十畝充人馬地，若不願充弓箭手，及出丁外尚有請占不盡地土，即拘收入官。」

translations.literal: We wish to petition that for households renting official fields before the eighth year of Xining, all first inquire of the tenants; if willing to enroll as archers, for each man furnished grant according to regulation the currently rented field of two qing and fifty mu as man-and-horse land; if unwilling to serve as archers, and beyond the men furnished there is still land claimed but not fully allotted, then confiscate and return it to the state."
translations.idiomatic: For official fields rented before Xining 8, tenants should first be consulted; those willing to enroll as archers would receive two qing fifty mu of their present holding per man furnished; those refusing, and any surplus land unassigned after enrollment, would revert to the state."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月，邊防司奏：「據提舉熙河蘭湟路弓箭手何灌申：漢人買田常多，比緣打量，其人亦不自安，首陳已及一千餘頃。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Border Defense Bureau memorialized: "According to the report submitted by He Guan, intendant of archers for the Xihe, Lanzhou, and Huangshui Circuit: Han people often purchase much land; recently, because of land surveys, those people are also unsettled, and those who have come forward already exceed one thousand-odd qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Border Defense Bureau reported: "According to a submission from He Guan, intendant of archers for the Xihe, Lanzhou, and Huangshui circuit: Han people often buy large amounts of land; because of the recent surveys, these people are also uneasy, and declarations have already reached more than one thousand qing.

sentences.zh: 若招弓箭手，即可得五百人；

translations.literal: If archers are recruited, five hundred men can immediately be obtained;
translations.idiomatic: If archers were recruited from this land, five hundred men could be raised at once;

sentences.zh: 若納租稅，每畝三斗五升、草二束，一歲間亦可得米三萬五千石、草二十萬束。

translations.literal: If rent and taxes are collected, at three dou and five sheng per mu and two bundles of fodder, within one year one can also obtain thirty-five thousand shi of grain and two hundred thousand bundles of fodder.
translations.idiomatic: If rent and taxes were levied at three dou and five sheng of grain per mu and two bundles of fodder, the circuit could also collect thirty-five thousand shi of grain and two hundred thousand bundles of fodder in a single year.

sentences.zh: 今相度欲將漢人置買到蕃部土田願爲弓箭手者，兩頃已上刺一名，四頃已上刺兩名。

translations.literal: Now, after deliberation, it is proposed that for Han people who have purchased tribal lands and wish to serve as archers, one man shall be recruited for every two qing or more, and two men for every four qing or more.
translations.idiomatic: After deliberation, the bureau proposed that Han men who had bought tribal land and wished to serve as archers should be registered at one man for every two qing or more, and two men for every four qing or more.

sentences.zh: 如願者，依條立定租稅輸納。

translations.literal: Those who volunteer shall pay fixed rent and taxes according to the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Volunteers would pay rent and taxes at the rates fixed under the regulations.

sentences.zh: 其巧爲影占者，重爲禁止。」

translations.literal: Those who craftily make fraudulent claims shall be strictly forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Those who fraudulently conceal or misrepresent holdings shall be strictly forbidden."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，詔：「熙、河、鄯、湟自開拓以來，疆土雖廣而地利悉歸屬羌，官兵吏祿仰給縣官，不可爲後計。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, an edict stated: "Since Xi, He, Shan, and Huang were opened up, although the territory is broad, all productive land belongs to the Qiang; the salaries of officers, soldiers, and clerks depend on the prefectural treasury—this cannot serve as a long-term plan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year, an edict said: "Since Xi, He, Shan, and Huang were opened, the territory is broad, yet all the land resources belong to the Qiang, while officials' and soldiers' salaries depend on the state treasury; this cannot be a long-term plan.

sentences.zh: 仰本路帥臣相度，以錢糧茶彩或以羌人所嗜之物，與之貿易田土。

translations.literal: The circuit commanders are ordered to deliberate and trade for farmland with money, grain, tea, cloth, or goods the Qiang favor.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit commanders were to consider trading money, grain, tea, dyed cloth, or other goods the Qiang desired in exchange for farmland.

sentences.zh: 田土既多，即招置弓箭手，入耕出戰，以固邊圉。」

translations.literal: Once farmland is ample, archers shall be recruited and settled to farm in peace and fight in war, thereby securing the border."
translations.idiomatic: Once there is much farmland, recruit archers to farm when at home and fight when abroad, thereby securing the frontier."

sentences.zh: 宣和六年七月，詔：「已降處分，陝西昨因地震摧塌屋宇，因而死傷弓箭手，內合承襲人，速具保明聞奏。」

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Xuanhe, an edict stated: "According to prior orders, in Shaanxi yesterday's earthquake collapsed buildings and thereby killed or wounded archers; heirs entitled to succession should promptly be verified and reported."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Xuanhe 6, an edict said: "Orders have already been issued: after the recent Shaanxi earthquake destroyed buildings and thereby killed or wounded archers, eligible heirs shall quickly be verified and reported."

sentences.zh: 靖康元年二月，臣僚言：「陝西恃弓箭手爲國藩籬，舊隸帥府，比年始置提舉弓箭手官，務取數多，自以爲功。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Jingkang, officials memorialized: "Shaanxi relies on archers as the nation's bulwark; they formerly were subordinate to the commandery, but in recent years an intendant of archers was created, striving only for large numbers as personal achievement.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Jingkang 1, officials said: "Shaanxi relies on archers as the state's frontier screen. They formerly belonged to the commander's office, but in recent years an archer-intendant official was first established, who sought high numbers and considered that achievement.

sentences.zh: 自是選練不精，遂使法制浸壞。

translations.literal: From then on selection and training were not refined, and the regulations gradually decayed.
translations.idiomatic: Selection and training thereafter grew slack, and the institution eroded.

sentences.zh: 欲乞詳酌，罷提舉官，以弓箭手復隸帥司，務求以振邊聲。」

translations.literal: We ask for careful deliberation to abolish the intendant and restore archers to the commandery, striving to revive the border's reputation."
translations.idiomatic: We request careful deliberation: abolish the intendant official, return the archers to the commander's office, and strive to revive the frontier's reputation."

sentences.zh: 詔從之，河東路依此。

translations.literal: The edict was followed; the Hedong Circuit followed this as well.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed; the Hedong Circuit was ordered to follow the same policy.

sentences.zh: 四月，樞密院奏：「陝西、河東逐路漢弓箭手自來並給肥饒田，近年以來，多將舊人已給田分擘，招刺新人。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: "In Shaanxi and Hedong each circuit, Han archers have always been granted fertile fields; in recent years many have subdivided land already granted to old recruits to register new men.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: "Han archers in the Shaanxi and Hedong circuits have always received fertile land, but in recent years officials have often split the lands already granted to old archers in order to recruit and register new men.

sentences.zh: 蓋緣提舉官貪賞欺蔽，務要數多，妄行招刺，無以激勸。

translations.literal: This was because intendants greedily sought rewards and deceived superiors, striving for numbers, recklessly registering men without effective incentives.
translations.idiomatic: Intendants had sought rewards and inflated numbers by improperly enrolling men without real incentives.

sentences.zh: 朝廷近已罷提舉官，今復隸帥司所轄，況當今邊事全藉民兵，若不早計，深慮誤事。」

translations.literal: The court has recently abolished the intendant; they are again under the commandery; moreover today's border affairs wholly depend on militia—if not planned early, there is deep fear of failure."
translations.idiomatic: The court has recently abolished the intendant official, and now they are again under the commander's office; moreover, today's frontier affairs depend entirely on militia. If this is not planned early, we deeply fear affairs will be mishandled."

sentences.zh: 詔令陝西五路制置使錢蓋及陝西、河東逐路帥臣相度措置，將已分擘弓箭手田土，依舊改正撥還，所有新招到人別行給地，務要均濟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Qian Gai, commissioner of the five Shaanxi circuits, and each circuit commander in Shaanxi and Hedong to deliberate and arrange matters: subdivided archer lands shall be corrected and returned as before; newly recruited men shall receive separate grants, with fairness required.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Commissioner Qian Gai of the five Shaanxi circuits and each Shaanxi and Hedong commander to restore subdivided archer lands to their original holders, grant separate plots to new recruits, and ensure equitable treatment.

sentences.zh: 仍仰帥臣嚴切奉行。

translations.literal: The commanders are further ordered to enforce this strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders were ordered to enforce the policy strictly.

sentences.zh: 是月，徐處仁又奏，詔並送詳議司。

translations.literal: In the same month, Xu Churen again memorialized; an edict sent both memorials to the Detailed Deliberation Office.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xu Churen submitted another memorial; both were sent to the Detailed Deliberation Office.

sentences.zh: 熙寧五年，涇原路經略司蔡挺言：「涇原勇敢三百四十四人，久不揀練，徒有虛名。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xining, Cai Ting of the Jingyuan Circuit pacification commission stated: "Three hundred forty-four Braves of Jingyuan have long gone without selection and training, bearing only empty names.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 5, Cai Ting of the Jingyuan pacification commission said: "Jingyuan has 344 Braves, but they have long gone unselected and undrilled, with only an empty name.

sentences.zh: 臣委二將領季一點閱，校其騎射能否升除，補有功者以爲隊長，募極塞博軍子嘗曆戰陣者補其闕。

translations.literal: I delegated two generals to inspect them each season, comparing mounted and foot archery to promote or demote; those with merit were made squad leaders, and sons of frontier Bohai soldiers with battle experience were recruited to fill gaps.
translations.idiomatic: He assigned two generals to quarterly inspections, promoting or demoting men by mounted and foot archery skill, appointing meritorious men as squad leaders and recruiting seasoned frontier soldiers to fill vacancies.

sentences.zh: 益募熟戶蕃部以爲蕃勇敢，凡一千三百八十人，騎一千一百九十四匹，挽弓一石，馳逐擊刺如法。

translations.literal: Tribal registered households were further recruited as tribal Braves—1,380 men in all, 1,194 mounts, drawing bows of one shi, charging and thrusting by regulation.
translations.idiomatic: He also recruited registered tribal households as tribal Braves—1,380 men with 1,194 horses, each drawing a one-shi bow and drilling in mounted charge and thrust.

sentences.zh: 其有功者受勇敢下等奉，餘遇調發，則人給奉三百，益以芻糧。」

translations.literal: Those with merit received the lowest Brave stipend; the rest, when mobilized, each received three hundred in pay plus fodder."
translations.idiomatic: Those with merit receive the lowest Brave stipend; when the rest are mobilized, each man receives a stipend of three hundred cash plus fodder and grain."

sentences.zh: 詔諸路如挺言行之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all circuits to act as Ting proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered every circuit to follow Cai Ting's model.

sentences.zh: 六年，樞密院言：「勇敢效用皆以材武應募從軍，廩食既優，戰馬戎械之具皆出公上，平時又得以家居，以勞效賞者凡四補而至借職，校弓箭手減十資，淹速相遠，甚非朝廷第功均賞之意。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Bureau of Military Affairs stated: "Effective Braves all enlist by martial talent; rations are generous, horses and weapons come from the state, and they may live at home in peacetime; by merit one may advance through four promotions to provisional rank—ten grades fewer than archers—a gap in speed that greatly departs from the court's intent to rank merit and reward evenly.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 6, the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "Braves and effectives all enlist for military skill; their rations are generous, their war horses, weapons, and armor all come from the state, and in peacetime they may live at home. Those rewarded for labor and merit advance in only four promotions to provisional rank; compared with archers this reduces ten grades, and the difference in speed is very great, which is far from the court's intent to rank merit and equalize rewards.

sentences.zh: 請自今河東、鄜延、秦鳳、環慶、熙河路各以三百，涇原路以五百爲額。

translations.literal: We ask that hereafter Hedong, Fuyan, Qinfeng, Huanqing, and Xihe each take three hundred as quota, and Jingyuan five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed quotas of three hundred Braves each for Hedong, Fuyan, Qinfeng, Huanqing, and Xihe, and five hundred for Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 第一等步射弓一石一斗，馬射九斗，奉錢千；

translations.literal: First grade: foot archery one shi one dou, mounted archery nine dou, stipend one thousand cash;
translations.idiomatic: First grade required one shi one dou at foot and nine dou mounted, with a stipend of one thousand cash;

sentences.zh: 第二等以下遞減一斗，奉七百至五百。

translations.literal: Each grade below decreases by one dou; stipends from seven hundred to five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: each lower grade reduced archery by one dou, with stipends from seven hundred to five hundred cash.

sentences.zh: 季首閱試于經略司，射親及野戰中者有賞，全不中者削其奉，次季又不中者罷之。

translations.literal: At the season's start they are inspected at the pacification commission; hits on targets or in field battle bring reward; complete misses reduce stipend; missing again next season brings dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal trials at the pacification commission rewarded hits in target or field combat; total misses cut stipends, and two seasons of failure meant dismissal.

sentences.zh: 戰有功者以八等定賞：一、給公據，二、以爲隊長，三、守闕軍將，四、軍將，五、殿侍，六、三班借差，七、差使，八、借職。

translations.literal: Battle merit is rewarded in eight grades: (1) official certificate, (2) squad leader, (3) acting army captain, (4) army captain, (5) palace attendant, (6) provisional Third Rank appointment, (7) dispatched service, (8) provisional rank.
translations.idiomatic: Eight grades of battle reward were set: official certificate, squad leader, acting army captain, army captain, palace attendant, provisional Third Rank appointment, dispatched service, and provisional rank.

sentences.zh: 其弓箭手有功，亦以八等定賞：一、押官，承局；

translations.literal: Archers with merit are also rewarded in eight grades: (1) pressing officer, clerk;
translations.idiomatic: Archers with merit had eight grades as well: pressing officer or clerk;

sentences.zh: 二、將，虞候，十將；

translations.literal: (2) captain, orderly, ten-captain;
translations.idiomatic: (2) captain, orderly, or ten-captain;

sentences.zh: 三、副兵馬使，軍使；

translations.literal: (3) vice cavalry commissioner, army commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: (3) vice cavalry commissioner or army commissioner;

sentences.zh: 四、副指揮使；

translations.literal: (4) vice commandant;
translations.idiomatic: (4) vice commandant;

sentences.zh: 五、都虞候；

translations.literal: (5) chief orderly;
translations.idiomatic: (5) chief orderly;

sentences.zh: 六、都指揮使；

translations.literal: (6) chief commandant;
translations.idiomatic: (6) chief commandant;

sentences.zh: 七、三班差使；

translations.literal: (7) Third Rank dispatched service;
translations.idiomatic: (7) Third Rank dispatched service;

sentences.zh: 八、借職。

translations.literal: (8) provisional rank.
translations.idiomatic: (8) provisional rank.

sentences.zh: 即以闕排連者次遷。」

translations.literal: Vacancies are filled in sequence by the next in line.
translations.idiomatic: Vacancies shall be filled in sequence by those next in line."

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，詔涇原路募勇敢如鄜延路，以百人爲額。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng, an edict ordered Jingyuan to recruit Braves as in the Fuyan Circuit, with a quota of one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanfeng, Jingyuan was ordered to recruit Braves on the Fuyan model, quota one hundred.

sentences.zh: 自是以後，蕃部益衆，而弓箭手多蕃兵矣。

translations.literal: From then on tribal groups grew ever larger, and archers became mostly tribal troops.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tribal numbers grew, and militia archers were increasingly tribal soldiers.

sentences.zh: 河北等路弓箭社

translations.literal: Bow-and-arrow societies in Hebei and other circuits
translations.idiomatic: Bow-and-Arrow Societies in Hebei and Other Circuits

sentences.zh: 弓箭社河北舊有之。

translations.literal: Bow-and-arrow societies long existed in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Bow-and-arrow societies had long existed in Hebei.

sentences.zh: 熙寧三年十二月，知定州滕甫言：「河北州縣近山谷處，民間各有弓箭社及獵射人，習慣便利，與夷人無異。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year of Xining, Teng Fu, prefect of Dingzhou, stated: "In Hebei prefectures and counties near mountains and valleys, the people each have bow-and-arrow societies and hunters; their skills are practiced and convenient, no different from barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Xining 3, Dingzhou prefect Teng Fu said: "In Hebei prefectures and counties near hills and valleys, commoners each have bow-and-arrow societies and hunters, accustomed to the terrain and as capable as the Yi peoples.

sentences.zh: 欲乞下本道逐州縣，並令募諸色公人及城郭鄉村百姓有武勇願習弓箭者，自爲之社。

translations.literal: We ask that this circuit's prefectures and counties be ordered to recruit clerks of all ranks and town and village commoners with martial courage who wish to practice archery, forming societies themselves.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that each county recruit willing clerks and townspeople with martial skill to form their own societies.

sentences.zh: 每歲之春，長吏就閱試之。

translations.literal: Each spring the chief official goes to inspect and test them.
translations.idiomatic: Each spring the local chief would inspect and test them.

sentences.zh: 北人勁悍，緩急可用。」

translations.literal: Northerners are stalwart; in emergency they can be used."
translations.idiomatic: Northerners are tough and fierce, and can be used in emergencies."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 元祐八年十一月，知定州蘇軾言：

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eighth year of Yuanyou, Su Shi, prefect of Dingzhou, stated:
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Yuanyou 8, Dingzhou prefect Su Shi memorialized:

sentences.zh: 北邊久和，河朔無事。

translations.literal: The northern border has long been at peace; the Hebei region is untroubled.
translations.idiomatic: The northern frontier had been peaceful and the Hebei region quiet.

sentences.zh: 沿邊諸郡，軍政少馳，將驕卒惰，緩急恐不可用；

translations.literal: Along the border commanderies military administration is lax, generals arrogant and soldiers idle—in emergency they may be unusable;
translations.idiomatic: Border prefectures had slack discipline, proud officers and idle troops who might fail in crisis;

sentences.zh: 武藝軍裝，皆不逮陝西、河東遠甚。

translations.literal: Martial skill and equipment fall far short of Shaanxi and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: their arms and training lagged far behind Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 雖據即目邊防事勢，三五年間必無警急，然居安慮危，有國之常，備事不素講，難以應變。

translations.literal: Although by present border conditions no alarm is likely within three to five years, to dwell in peace yet think of danger is a nation's constant; if preparations are not discussed beforehand, change cannot be met.
translations.idiomatic: Su Shi granted that no crisis seemed likely within a few years, yet nations must prepare in peace; without prior planning, emergencies could not be met.

sentences.zh: 臣觀祖宗以來，沿邊要害，屯聚重兵，止以壯國威而消敵謀，蓋所謂先聲後實，形格勢禁之道耳。

translations.literal: I observe that since the founding ancestors, at key border points heavy forces were massed only to strengthen national prestige and dispel enemy designs—the so-called "sound before substance," checking by posture and constraint.
translations.idiomatic: He observed that since the founding era heavy garrisons on key frontiers had served chiefly to overawe enemies by presence—the classic "thunder before rain" strategy of deterrence.

sentences.zh: 若進取深入，交鋒兩陣，猶當雜用禁旅。

translations.literal: If advancing deep and clashing in pitched battle, regular imperial troops should still be mixed in.
translations.idiomatic: Deep offensives and pitched battles still required regular imperial troops.

sentences.zh: 至於平日保境，備禦小寇，即須專用極邊土人。

translations.literal: For daily border defense against small raids, frontier locals alone must be employed.
translations.idiomatic: Day-to-day defense against small raids, he argued, must rely on frontier locals alone.

sentences.zh: 此古今不易之論也。

translations.literal: This is a principle unchanged through antiquity and the present.
translations.idiomatic: That principle, he said, had never changed.

sentences.zh: 晁錯與漢文帝畫備邊策，不過二事：其一曰徙遠方以實空虛，其二曰制邊縣以備敵國。

translations.literal: Chao Cuo and Emperor Wen of Han plotted border defense with only two measures: first, relocate distant peoples to fill empty lands; second, organize border counties against enemy states.
translations.idiomatic: Chao Cuo and Emperor Wen had outlined border defense in two moves: relocate outsiders to fill empty districts and organize frontier counties against enemies.

sentences.zh: 寶元、慶曆中，趙元昊反，屯兵四十余萬，招刺宣毅、保捷二十五萬人，皆不得其用，卒無成功。

translations.literal: In the Baoyuan and Qingli eras Zhao Yuanhao rebelled; four hundred thousand troops were stationed and two hundred fifty thousand Xuanyi and Baojie militia recruited—all proved useless and success was never achieved.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Yuanhao rebelled in the Baoyuan and Qingli eras, despite 400,000 troops and 250,000 levied militia, nothing availed and the campaign failed.

sentences.zh: 范仲淹、劉{山成}、種世衡等專務整緝蕃漢熟戶、弓箭手，所以封殖其家、砥礪其人者非一道。

translations.literal: Fan Zhongyan, Liu Yicheng, Zhong Shihang, and others devoted themselves to organizing registered tribal Han households and archers, nurturing families and sharpening men by many means.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhongyan, Liu Yicheng, Zhong Shihang, and others focused on organizing registered tribal households and archers, supporting families and hardening men by many means.

sentences.zh: 藩籬既成，賊來無所得，故元昊復臣。

translations.literal: Once the bulwark was complete, when bandits came they gained nothing; hence Yuanhao again submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Once that bulwark stood, raiders gained nothing and Yuanhao resubmitted.

sentences.zh: 今河朔西路被邊州軍，自澶淵講和以來，百姓自相團結爲弓箭社，不論家業高下，戶出一人。

translations.literal: Now on the Hebei western border, since the Chanyuan peace the people have organized bow-and-arrow societies themselves, regardless of household wealth, one man per household.
translations.idiomatic: On the Hebei western frontier since the Chanyuan treaty, households had formed bow-and-arrow societies on their own, contributing one man regardless of wealth.

sentences.zh: 又自相推擇家資武藝衆所服者爲社頭、社副、錄事，謂之頭目。

translations.literal: They also choose by mutual agreement men of means and martial skill whom all respect as society head, deputy, and recorder—these are called leaders.
translations.idiomatic: They elected respected men of means and skill as head, deputy, and recorder— the "leaders."

sentences.zh: 帶弓而鋤，佩劍而樵，出入山阪，飲食長技與敵國同。

translations.literal: Bow on the back while hoeing, sword at the belt while gathering firewood; entering and leaving hills, diet and skills match the enemy's.
translations.idiomatic: They farmed with bows slung and cut wood with swords belted, living in the hills with the same skills and diet as the enemy.

sentences.zh: 私立賞罰，嚴於官府，分番巡邏，鋪屋相望，若透漏北賊及本土強盜不獲，其當番人皆有重罰。

translations.literal: Private rewards and punishments are stricter than the government; they patrol in shifts with watch houses in sight; if northern bandits or local robbers escape capture, those on duty face heavy penalties.
translations.idiomatic: Private discipline exceeded official law; shift patrols linked watch posts, and failure to catch northern raiders or local bandits brought heavy punishment on the duty rotation.

sentences.zh: 遇其警急，擊鼓，頃刻可致千人。

translations.literal: When alarm comes, beating drums can gather a thousand men in moments.
translations.idiomatic: At alarm, drumbeats could muster a thousand men within moments.

sentences.zh: 器甲鞍馬，常若寇至。

translations.literal: Armor, saddles, and horses are kept as if enemies were at hand.
translations.idiomatic: Armor, saddles, and horses were kept battle-ready.

sentences.zh: 蓋親戚墳墓所在，人自爲戰，敵深畏之。

translations.literal: Because kin and graves are there, men fight for themselves and enemies deeply fear them.
translations.idiomatic: With kin and graves at stake, men fought for themselves and enemies feared them deeply.

sentences.zh: 先朝名臣帥定州者韓琦、龐籍，皆加意拊循其人，以爲爪牙耳目之用，而籍又增損其約束賞罰。

translations.literal: Former renowned ministers who commanded Dingzhou—Han Qi and Pang Ji—both took care to govern and comfort these people as claws, fangs, eyes, and ears; Ji also revised their rules of reward and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Former Dingzhou commanders Han Qi and Pang Ji had carefully governed and comforted them as local eyes and ears; Pang Ji had also adjusted their rules of reward and punishment.

sentences.zh: 熙寧六年，行保甲法，強壯、弓箭社並行廢罷。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xining the baojia system was implemented and the strong-men and bow-and-arrow societies were abolished together.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 6 the baojia system was imposed and strong-men and bow-and-arrow societies were abolished together.

sentences.zh: 熙甯七年，應兩地供輸人戶，除元有弓箭社、強壯並義勇之類並依舊存留外，更不編排保甲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xining, for dual-supply households, except existing bow-and-arrow societies, strong men, and yiyong units retained as before, baojia was no longer organized.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 7 dual-supply households kept existing societies, strong men, and yiyong units but were not reorganized into baojia.

sentences.zh: 看詳上件兩次聖旨，除兩地供輸村分方許依舊置弓箭社，其餘併合廢罷。

translations.literal: Reviewing the two prior imperial orders, only dual-supply villages might retain bow-and-arrow societies; all others should be abolished together.
translations.idiomatic: Review of those orders showed only dual-supply villages might keep societies; all others should have been abolished.

sentences.zh: 雖有上件指揮，公私相承，元不廢罷，只是令弓箭社兩丁以上人戶兼充保甲，以至逐捕本界及他盜賊，並皆驅使弓箭社人戶用命捉殺。

translations.literal: Although those orders existed, in practice they were never abolished—societies with two or more males simply doubled as baojia, and in hunting local or outside bandits bow-and-arrow households were driven to capture and kill.
translations.idiomatic: In practice societies were never abolished; multi-male households simply doubled as baojia, and counties drove bow-and-arrow households to hunt bandits.

sentences.zh: 見今州縣，全藉此等寅夜防拓，灼見弓箭社實爲邊防要用，其勢決不可廢。

translations.literal: Present prefectures and counties wholly rely on them for night patrol; it is clear bow-and-arrow societies are essential to border defense and absolutely cannot be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Counties now relied on them for night patrol; bow-and-arrow societies were plainly vital to border defense and could not be abolished.

sentences.zh: 但以兼充保甲之故，召集追呼，勞費失業，今雖名目俱存，責其實用，不逮往日。

translations.literal: But because they also serve as baojia, summons and chase waste labor and livelihood; though the names remain, their practical utility falls short of former days.
translations.idiomatic: Yet dual service as baojia wasted time and livelihood; though the institutions survived, their practical value had declined.

sentences.zh: 臣竊謂陝西、河東弓箭手，官給良田，以備甲馬。

translations.literal: I privately observe that Shaanxi and Hedong archers receive good official land to equip armor and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi and Hedong archers received official land for arms and horses, he noted.

sentences.zh: 今河朔沿邊弓箭社，皆是人戶祖業田產，官無絲毫之損，而捐軀捍邊，器甲鞍馬與陝西、河東無異，苦樂相遠，未盡其用。

translations.literal: Now Hebei frontier bow-and-arrow societies use hereditary household land with no loss to the state, yet they risk their lives defending the border with the same arms and horses as Shaanxi and Hedong—the disparity in hardship means their potential is not fully used.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei societies used hereditary land at no cost to the state yet defended the border with the same gear as Shaanxi and Hedong; unequal hardship left their strength underused.

sentences.zh: 近日霸州文安縣及真定府北砦，皆有北賊驚劫人戶，捕盜官吏拱手相視，無如之何，以驗禁軍、弓手皆不得力。

translations.literal: Recently in Wen'an County of Bazhou and the northern fort of Zhending Prefecture northern bandits robbed households; catch-bandit officials stood by helpless, proving imperial troops and archer units were ineffective.
translations.idiomatic: Recent raids in Wen'an, Bazhou, and Zhending's northern fort had left officials helpless, showing regular troops and archers were ineffective.

sentences.zh: 向使州縣逐處皆有弓箭社，人戶致命盡力，則北賊豈敢輕犯邊砦，如入無人之境？

translations.literal: If every county had bow-and-arrow societies and households gave their lives, would northern bandits dare lightly violate border forts as if entering empty land?
translations.idiomatic: If every county had active societies willing to die in defense, northern raiders would not stroll through border forts unopposed.

sentences.zh: 臣已戒飭本路將吏，申嚴賞罰，加意拊循其人，輒復拾用龐籍舊奏約束，稍加增損，別立條目。

translations.literal: I have already admonished this circuit's officers to enforce rewards and punishments and govern and comfort these people with care, again adopting Pang Ji's former memorial rules with slight revisions and separate articles.
translations.idiomatic: He had admonished local officers to enforce rewards and punishments and govern and comfort the people carefully, reviving Pang Ji's old rules with revisions in separate articles.

sentences.zh: 欲乞朝廷立法，少賜優異，明設賞罰，以示懲勸。

translations.literal: I wish to ask the court to legislate, grant slight preferment, and set clear rewards and punishments to show encouragement and warning.
translations.idiomatic: He asked the court to legislate modest privileges and clear rewards and punishments as encouragement.

sentences.zh: 今已密切取會到本路極邊定、保兩州、安肅、廣信、順安三軍邊面七縣一砦內管自來團結弓箭社五百八十八社，六百五十一火，共計三萬一千四百一十一人。

translations.literal: I have closely consulted the extreme frontier of this circuit—Ding and Bao prefectures, Ansuz, Guangxin, and Shun'an commands, seven counties and one fort on the border—where self-organized bow-and-arrow societies number 588 societies, 651 households, totaling 31,411 men.
translations.idiomatic: He had ascertained that on the frontier of Ding and Bao, three commands, seven counties, and one fort there were 588 societies, 651 household units, totaling 31,411 men.

sentences.zh: 若朝廷以爲可行，立法之後，更敕將吏常加拊循，使三萬餘人分番晝夜巡邏，盜邊小寇來即擒獲，不至狃忲以生戎心。

translations.literal: If the court finds this feasible, after legislation officers should constantly govern and comfort them so thirty thousand men patrol day and night in shifts, capturing small border raiders at once, so they do not grow bold through habit and rouse barbarian ambition.
translations.idiomatic: If approved, officers should constantly govern and comfort them so 30,000 men patrolled in shifts, catching small raiders immediately and not letting habit embolden enemies.

sentences.zh: 而事皆循舊，無所改作，敵不疑畏，無由生事，有利無害，較然可見。

translations.literal: Yet affairs would follow old ways with no changes; enemies would not suspect or fear, no cause for trouble would arise—benefit without harm is plainly visible.
translations.idiomatic: Routine would continue unchanged; enemies would neither suspect nor be provoked—clear benefit without harm.

sentences.zh: 奏凡兩上，皆不報。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted twice; neither time received response.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted twice; neither memorial was answered.

sentences.zh: 政和六年，詔：「河北路有弓箭社縣分，已令解發異等。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenghe, an edict stated: "In Hebei counties with bow-and-arrow societies, outstanding grades have been ordered forwarded.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe 6 an edict said: "In Hebei counties with bow-and-arrow societies, men of exceptional grade have already been ordered forwarded upward.

sentences.zh: 其逐路縣令佐，俟歲終教閱異等，帥司具優劣之最，各取旨賞罰，以爲勸沮。

translations.literal: Each circuit's county magistrates and assistants, after year-end drill review of grades, shall have the commandery report best and worst for imperial reward and punishment as encouragement and deterrence.
translations.idiomatic: County magistrates were to hold year-end drills; commanderies would report best and worst for imperial reward and punishment.

sentences.zh: 仍具爲令。」

translations.literal: They shall also be recorded as precedent."
translations.idiomatic: These rules shall also be codified as statutes."

sentences.zh: 又高陽關路安撫司言：「大觀三年弓箭社人依《保甲法》、《政和保甲格》較最優劣，縣令各減展磨勘年有差。」

translations.literal: The Gaoyang Pass Circuit pacification commission stated: "In the third year of Daguan, bow-and-arrow society members were ranked by the Baojia Law and Zhenghe baojia regulations; magistrates' merit-review years were reduced by varying amounts."
translations.idiomatic: The Gaoyang Pass pacification commission also said: "In Daguan 3, bow-and-arrow society members were ranked as superior or inferior under the Baojia Law and the Zhenghe Baojia Regulations, and county magistrates each had merit-review years reduced or extended by varying degrees."

sentences.zh: 詔依《保甲格》賞罰施行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered rewards and punishments applied per the Baojia regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered rewards and punishments under the baojia regulations.

sentences.zh: 宣和七年二月，臣僚言：

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year of Xuanhe, officials stated:
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Xuanhe 7, officials memorialized:

sentences.zh: 往年西路提刑梁揚祖奏請勸誘民戶充弓箭社，繼下東路令仿西路例招誘。

translations.literal: In former years Western Circuit intendant Liang Yangzu memorialized to induce households into bow-and-arrow societies; the Eastern Circuit was then ordered to follow the Western example in recruitment.
