translations.idiomatic: Western Circuit intendant Liang Yangzu had urged households into societies; the Eastern Circuit was then ordered to follow suit.

sentences.zh: 原立法之意，不過使鄉民自願入社者閱習武備，爲禦賊之具爾。

translations.literal: The original legislative intent was merely that villagers who voluntarily joined would drill arms as equipment against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The law had meant only voluntary members would drill for self-defense.

sentences.zh: 奈何邀功生事之人，唯以入社之民衆多爲功，厚誣朝廷而斂怨於民，督責州縣急於星火，取五等之籍甲乙而次之，家至戶到，追胥迫脅。

translations.literal: Yet those seeking merit and trouble took numbers enrolled as achievement, greatly deceiving the court while heaping resentment on the people, pressing prefectures and counties like fire, ranking households from fifth-class registers from door to door, with runners coercing them.
translations.idiomatic: Merit-seekers counted enrollments as achievement, deceiving the court and angering the people, pressing counties urgently, ranking fifth-class household registers house by house with coercive runners.

sentences.zh: 悉驅之入社，更無免者。

translations.literal: All were driven into societies; none were exempt.
translations.idiomatic: All were driven into societies without exception.

sentences.zh: 法始行于西路，西路既已冒受厚賞，於是東路憲司前後論列，誕謾滋甚。

translations.literal: The law began in the Western Circuit; having already received rich rewards there, Eastern Circuit surveillance commissioners repeatedly memorialized with ever grosser exaggeration.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Circuit had already received lavish rewards; Eastern surveillance memorials grew ever more inflated.

sentences.zh: 近者東路之奏，數至二十四萬一千七百人，武藝優長者一十一萬六千，且雲比之西路僅多一倍。

translations.literal: Recently the Eastern Circuit reported 241,700 men, 116,000 excelling in martial skill, claiming only twice the Western Circuit's numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Circuit lately reported 241,700 men and 116,000 skilled fighters—claiming only double the west.

sentences.zh: 陛下灼知其不然，雖命帥臣與廉訪使者核實，彼安肯以實聞乎？

translations.literal: Your Majesty clearly knows this is not so; although commanders and surveillance commissioners are ordered to verify, how would they dare report the truth?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor knew this was false; though ordered to verify, commanders and inspectors would hardly report truthfully.

sentences.zh: 今東路憲司官屬與登、淄兩州當職官，坐增秩者幾二十人，而縣令、佐不及焉。

translations.literal: Now nearly twenty officials of the Eastern Circuit surveillance commission and the incumbent officers of Deng and Zi prefectures have received rank increases for this, while county magistrates and assistants have not.
translations.idiomatic: Nearly twenty Eastern Circuit surveillance staff and incumbent officers in Deng and Zi prefectures had already received rank promotions for this work, while county magistrates and assistants had not.

sentences.zh: 不知出入阡陌間勸誘者誰歟？

translations.literal: Who then goes among the field paths to persuade and induce them?
translations.idiomatic: Who, then, was actually walking the lanes to recruit them?

sentences.zh: 此其誕謾可知矣。

translations.literal: From this their exaggeration can be known.
translations.idiomatic: The exaggeration was obvious.

sentences.zh: 審如所奏，山東之寇，何累月淹時未見殄減哉？

translations.literal: If it truly were as memorialized, why have bandits in Shandong lingered for months without being wiped out?
translations.idiomatic: If the numbers were real, why had Shandong bandits not been suppressed after many months?

sentences.zh: 則其所奏二十四萬與十一萬，殆虛有名，不足以捍賊明矣！

translations.literal: Then their reported 240,000 and 116,000 are nearly empty names, plainly insufficient to repel bandits!
translations.idiomatic: The claimed 241,000 and 116,000 were largely fictitious and clearly could not fight bandits.

sentences.zh: 大抵因緣追擾，民不堪其勞，則老弱轉徙道路，強壯起爲盜賊，此亦致寇之一端也。

translations.literal: Generally because of continual pursuit and harassment the people cannot bear the toil; the old and weak wander on the roads, the strong rise as bandits—this too is one source of producing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Endless harassment drove the people to exhaustion: the old and weak fled on the roads and the strong turned bandit—another way the policy bred outlaws.

sentences.zh: 近者仰煩陛下遣將出師，授以方略，又命近臣持詔撫諭，至於發內庫之藏，轉淮甸之粟以振給之，寬免其稅租，蕩宥其罪戾，丁寧纖悉，罔不曲盡。

translations.literal: Recently Your Majesty has troubled to send generals with strategies, ordered close ministers to carry edicts of reassurance, opened the inner treasury, shifted Huai-region grain for relief, waived taxes and rents, pardoned crimes—every detail meticulously addressed, nothing left incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the emperor had sent generals with plans, dispatched close ministers with reassuring edicts, opened the inner treasury, moved Huai grain for relief, waived taxes, and pardoned crimes—every care taken.

sentences.zh: 方將歸伏田畝，以爲遷善遠罪之民，詎可以其所甚病擾之邪？

translations.literal: Just as they were about to return to their fields as people turning to goodness and shunning crime—how can they be harassed with what they most dread?
translations.idiomatic: Just as people were returning to their fields to reform, how could they be tormented with what they feared most?

sentences.zh: 且私有兵器，在律之禁甚嚴。

translations.literal: Moreover private possession of weapons is strictly forbidden by law.
translations.idiomatic: Private arms were strictly forbidden by law.

sentences.zh: 三路保伍之法，雖于農隙以講武事，然猶事畢則兵器藏於官府。

translations.literal: Under the baowu system of the three circuits, although martial affairs are drilled in agricultural slack seasons, when finished weapons are stored in government offices.
translations.idiomatic: Under the three-circuit baowu system, drill occurred in farming slack seasons and weapons were then stored in government offices.

sentences.zh: 今弓箭社一切兵器，民皆自藏於家，不幾於借寇哉？

translations.literal: Now all bow-and-arrow society weapons are kept by the people at home—is this not nearly lending arms to bandits?
translations.idiomatic: Now bow-and-arrow society weapons stayed in private homes—was that not arming bandits?

sentences.zh: 望陛下斷自聖心，罷京東弓箭社之名，所藏兵器悉送之官，使民得免非時追呼迫脅之擾，以安其生。

translations.literal: We hope Your Majesty will decide in your sage heart to abolish the name of bow-and-arrow societies in the Jingdong Circuit, send all stored weapons to the government, and let the people escape untimely summons, chase, and coercion so their livelihoods may be secure.
translations.idiomatic: He asked the emperor to abolish Jingdong bow-and-arrow societies, confiscate all weapons, and spare the people untimely summons and coercion.

sentences.zh: 應兩路緣弓箭社推恩者並追奪改正，首議之人重賜黜責，後爲奏請誕謾，亦乞特賜施行，庶幾群下悚懼，不敢妄進曲說，以肆其奸，實今日之先務也。

translations.literal: Those granted favor in both circuits because of bow-and-arrow societies should all have it revoked and corrected; the originators should be heavily punished and demoted; those who later memorialized with exaggeration should also be specially punished—so that subordinates may fear and not dare advance crooked proposals to indulge their deceit; this is truly today's foremost task.
translations.idiomatic: Promotions granted in both circuits for society work should be revoked, initiators punished, and later fabricators penalized so officials would fear to lie—an urgent priority.

sentences.zh: 詔並依奏，梁揚祖落職，兵器並拘入官，弓箭社人依已降指揮放散。

translations.literal: An edict followed the memorial in all points; Liang Yangzu was dismissed from office, weapons were all confiscated to the government, and bow-and-arrow society members were dispersed according to prior orders.
translations.idiomatic: The court accepted the memorial: Liang Yangzu was dismissed, weapons confiscated, and society members dispersed under existing orders.
